Until 2026-09-16 the live document was the Google Doc [Universe 24 Highlights](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IkhSyqZZMBSgbJV-PMMwcXG0D_Rlfg4FrLy2jXBMUSs/edit); this file was taken verbatim from its revision of 2026-09-16 at 11:57 UTC, and the Google Doc is the historical source up to that revision, neither edited nor resynced. # 1. Purpose and navigation

This file is the head of the specification: what the system is, what it measures, how a measurement connects to the world, and where each rule lives. Adopted decisions, proposed profiles, implemented mechanisms and tested results stay distinct; an implementation gap does not reopen a decision, and no document invents a missing physical law. The law's contract is [BEAM_LAW.md](BEAM_LAW.md); the names are [TERMINOLOGY.md](TERMINOLOGY.md); the engine's steps and record are [ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md); the decisions are section 5.4; the mathematics is [DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md](DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md); the connection of clicks from Inside to Outside is [the click frame](designs/click_frame/DERIVATION.md); the registered readings are [EXPERIMENTS.md](EXPERIMENTS.md) and [NATURE.md](NATURE.md).

**The system on 2026-09-22.**

1. **The GameBoard.** One discrete world: the cubic lattice of Nodes, six Ports each in Port order +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z, a Link to each neighbour one unit step on one axis, the faces per axis open or periodic, an open face a detector named `face:+x` .. `face:-z` on which every row or body that leaves clicks; `GameBoard` in code, the only noun for it ([record 5](LOG_2026-09-20.md#05-decided-the-name-of-the-board-is-gameboard); [TERMINOLOGY, the location](TERMINOLOGY.md#the-location)). The whole of it is one state vector on the product torus, and nothing is outside it but the detectors' readings (the paragraph "The name" below; [record 181](LOG_2026-09-20.md#181-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0110z-the-owners-words-translated-so-the-system-becomes-vectors-tensors-and-operations-on-them-where-the-gameboard-checks-and-computes-when-there-is-a-limit-and-put-it-in-highlights-and-why-it-is-right-the-statement-the-state-is-integer-vectors-on-tori-a-row-a-record-a-bodys-counts-and-one-tensor-the-readings-order-2-moment-the-law-one-map-f-per-interval-at-every-node-made-of-six-operations-a-translation-by-a-rate-with-a-threshold-a-multiplication-by-a-declared-matrix-an-addition-an-inner-product-a-permutation-an-evaluation-and-the-gameboard-computes-exactly-where-the-formula-has-only-a-limit-a-constant-rate-gives-the-closed-form-floors_0--r-t-and-the-board-only-confirms-it-a-state-dependent-rate-gives-a-difference-equation-with-no-closed-form-whose-exact-solution-is-the-boards-iteration-and-whose-limit-is-the-derivations-differential-equation-the-measurement-the-one-threshold-read-out-why-it-holds-1-the-inventory-of-every-rule-of-beam-v1-finds-each-one-of-the-six-operations-or-a-declared-rounding-at-load-record-168-so-the-statement-is-a-fact-of-the-code-not-a-hope-2-the-two-steps-that-look-like-exceptions-are-not-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-is-a-bijection-z--zd-x-z-whose-carry-is-the-event-the-definition-of-a-whole-quantum-record-173-and-the-clicks-weight-is-the-inner-product-of-the-pointer-with-itself-through-the-couplings-primitive-record-173-so-nothing-is-squared-as-a-step-of-its-own-3-the-constant-rate-closed-form-reproduces-the-register-exactly-the-bell-cells-by-the-papers-s_of_n-the-cones-pins-before-its-run-the-64-registered-clicks-of-slits_low-by-the-map-record-156-so-computed-before-the-run-is-verified-4-the-feedback-class-has-no-closed-form-in-principle-the-rate-reads-the-state-so-the-iteration-is-the-only-exact-solution-and-the-boards-necessity-is-a-theorem-while-the-continuum-limit-is-the-derivations-and-the-pairing-checks-both-records-167-176-5-it-is-the-division-natures-theories-have-linear-evolution-between-measurements-the-nonlinear-classical-limit-one-read-out-and-the-laws-numbers-quantise-exactly-what-lives-on-a-compact-group-predictions-26-record-179-what-the-law-does-not-reach-is-stated-in-the-same-terms-the-contraction-gamma-needs-is-a-root-of-the-state-not-one-of-the-six-record-178)).
2. **The state.** Between intervals a Node holds nothing but the rows present at it and the body there; a Node keeps no wave, no register, no remainder and no draw ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception); the third test, [record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201)). A row, `NatureBeam`, the record of an event in transit: its Node, its direction (an index of the world's direction table), its age, its phase on the circle of N, its number, its amount and its content per unit; identical rows at one Node are one row with the amounts added ([BEAM_LAW section 2](BEAM_LAW.md#2-the-record-of-a-ray-and-the-world-file)). A body, a measured event, an event created here without end: its held content per family, its momentum vector **p** (the label, content x **u**_d per unit along its direction at the scale Q = 64), its phase, its clock (the count of its self-creations) and its counts table, one bounded accumulator per count with its remainder kept ([BEAM_LAW section 5](BEAM_LAW.md#5-the-detectors-record-the-re-emission-the-face-detectors), note 41; [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception)). **The name.** *Universe* is the one discrete world the simulator realises: the GameBoard of Nodes and Links with its Events, the whole of it one state vector on the product torus, and nothing outside it but the detector's reading; the framework is Reality Theory, the simulator Universe24 ([README](../README.md)). *24* is the number of rotations of that world's own symmetry: the six Ports of a Node are the six vertices of an octahedron, and the octahedron has exactly 24 rotations onto itself (and 24 more with a reflection, 48 in all, the two halves told apart by the hand); those 24 rotations are what the GameBoard has in place of the continuous rotation group, and a Lorentz boost, which mixes a space step with a time step, is not among them, which is why Lorentz's symmetry belongs to the limit and not to the group. Universe24 is the universe of the 24 rotations (the model owner, 2026-09-21, [record # 2. Intuitive picture: multidimensional Snake

The picture of 2026-09-17 under this heading (four definitions and one principle: the ray, the Detector's bit, the phase at the family's rest rate, the field ray, and the Snake) is history, kept verbatim in [section 10](#10-the-head-and-the-reading-map-before-2026-09-22-history); every one of its items was superseded in turn by the law of the bit, the law of the shadow, the law of events and the Beam Law (section 5.4, the decisions of 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-19). The picture today is the owner's: "The world is the list of clicks. The GameBoard computes every possible future between click and click, and the next click chooses and adds a row to the list. Classical and quantum are the same GameBoard at a different density of clicks. One law, one measurement, one world." ([record 77](LOG_2026-09-20.md#77-the-corrected-sentence-without-a-caveat-and-the-wave)); "Nature communicates with itself by clicks": births the questions, clicks the answers, the world the On the GameBoard there are only events: a row is an event in transit, a body an event created here without end ([record 21](LOG_2026-09-20.md#21-and-there-is-no-ray-there-is-only-an-event)); the GameBoard is deterministic and the detectors' world is not ([record 15](LOG_2026-09-20.md#15-decided-the-gameboard-is-deterministic-the-detectors-world-is-not-by-the-uncertainty-in-the-detectors-world)); the API of the GameBoard is an emitter in and a detector out ([record 53](LOG_2026-09-20.md#53-decided-the-api-of-the-gameboard-is-an-emitter-in-and-a-detector-out)).

# 3. Foundational postulates

## 3.1 Discrete local space

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray): the GameBoard's faces are open by default, a periodic axis declared, a closed board refused; nothing at a Node ([record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception)).]*

The adopted board is a connected three-dimensional cubic network. Each local Node connects to six neighboring Nodes through directional Ports and Links. The selected layout is periodic; boundary choices belong to explicit experiment configuration. NodeState is the unit of local state. No fixed private-register decomposition or 36-register layer is required. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.2 Ordinary Node dynamics are local

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray) and [record 28 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#28-detector-as-physical-nodes-cell-sensitivity-and-information): nothing returns, no number travels; a detector is a declared set of measured events.]*

An ordinary Node operation uses only its own bounded state and information that has causally arrived through its Links. It cannot read another Node's live state or apply an instantaneous distant field, movement or inventory update. There is no exception: the Detector of section 3.19 is a Node like any other, and the number a pair shares travels on the returning ray (section 5.4). Section 3.18, which described a shared quantum-resource exception, was deleted on 2026-09-17. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: no number travels on a returning ray, since nothing returns; Bell is two events of one field at two places, each born of the local field and the local setting (reading (vii) there). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.3 Ray-form propagation is fundamental

rows and bodies, the phase stamped at birth and turned per Link, the Born rule the Gram form of the tables ([record **Two definitions.** The board contains Node states and their properties, not a separate fundamental object called a ray. A ray names the universal form in which those properties propagate through neighboring Nodes. The system has exactly two definitions, event and ray: a ray carries information, and an event is where that information splits; a ray is what was split off from an event. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: the two definitions are shadow and event; every ray is a shadow, a whole quantum of a family in flight, and an event is a whole quantum at a Node that holds content, from which the shadows spread ("The shadow spreads like a ray from the event"); what a split is as a table is round 8's. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: one definition, the event; nothing splits below one, and a single event leaves a Node whole in one direction.)

**Interaction and event.** An interaction is a meeting of rays at a Node, decided by the coupling declared between their families, and its result is at most six events, one per Port. An event is a change of trajectory: a new straight line leaving the interaction. A ray is the trajectory of one event between two interactions, reversible in time; a Node that a ray merely crosses hosts no event. From its event, every ray carries the number of steps it has made (for a shadow, retired on 2026-09-18: its return is a field with no step count, section 5.4, point 3). Outside a Detector every trajectory an interaction permits actually happens; alternatives arise only at interactions. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: no ray is the trajectory of one event and none counts steps, since nothing walks a path of its own; a shadow spreads from its event by the Node's mixing, and an interaction is a whole quantum at held content, absorbed, held or released again by the family's table. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Phase.** Every ray is a wave ray and carries a phase; a plain ray is a special case of the wave ray, not a second kind. Light is a wave ray with no mass and no charge. Three things change a phase and nothing else: each interval advances it at the rest rate its family declares, which is the ray's mass as a clock, and that rate is zero for light, whose phase does not advance along its own line; an interaction changes it as the declared coupling says; a bound group advances it once per interval it is held. A light ray carries the phase of the clock that emitted it at the moment of emission and delivers it unchanged, so the frequency of light is the rate of its emitter's clock. Since 2026-09-18 the rate is not declared: a thing advances its phase by its content / K per interval, one K for the world, and a shadow has no clock (section 5.4, point 19). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: the phase of every ray rotates by its content over K, a shadow's included, light's content being its amount ("the phase rotates like a ray"); a release stamps the holder's phase, and a quantum absorbed and released again carries the holder's phase and number (reading (iv) there); the clock of held content is its release, which slows in a potential (reading (iii)). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Amplitude and interference.** There is no amplitude as a number and no probability field: the phase and the ray's conserved content together are the discrete stand-in for the quantum amplitude, the phase as its angle and the conserved content as its size. Because every trajectory an interaction permits actually happens, the intensity at a place is how much content arrived there, and interference is steering: where rays meet in one layer, the declared coupling reads their phase difference and decides through which Port the shared content leaves, with every invariant exact; nothing is erased. The basic steering coupling is the Born rule stated as a coupling: for a phase difference δ it splits the shared content between the two candidate Ports in the ratio cos²(δ/2) to sin²(δ/2), as a declared table of bounded integer ratios with the remainder owned as section 3.17 requires, so that click intensities follow the Born rule with nothing read by any Detector. It is declared, not derived. Since 2026-09-18 the table is computed from the family's phase width N and declared by no one (section 5.4, point 17). The Detector reads none of this; the probability of a click is already in how much content reached it. Interference of light follows from this alone: two paths of different length reach one place at one time only if their rays were emitted at different times, so they carry different emission phases, and the difference is the emitter's rate times the difference in path length; nothing is accumulated on the way. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: the shared content leaves by the Node's mixing (point 24), for every ray; a click is the whole quantum the parked parts make where they reach one, one absorption at one Node, and the distribution over many is the amount's, Born by counting (reading (vi) there). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: "every trajectory actually happens" holds of a bundle, whose shares reach wholes at a crowded Node; a single quantum takes one path, by its momentum, and does not interfere with itself, interference being of many of one number; and "nothing is accumulated on the way" stands again, an event in transit does not turn.)

**Field and matter.** A traveling ray releases a field, and the field is itself made of rays (section 3.5). There is no additional substance called matter (section 3.4); references to rays below refer to this propagation and its interaction patterns. Since 2026-09-18 the field of a thing is its shadow set, given with the board and not released per interval (section 5.4, "A thing does not emit"). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: matter is content held at a Node, it releases shadows every interval in proportion to its content ("A thing emits"), every ray is a shadow, and nothing is given with the board. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**There is no light and no matter (model owner, 2026-09-18).** There is one kind of content, the ray, and nothing else: an electron, a proton, the light an atom emits and the field a charge releases are the same ray with different declared properties (rate, charge, amount, binding) and one bit. The words light, matter, field, photon and radiation name patterns and roles, never kinds; no rule of the model may read "light" or "matter" as a category. What the bit says, the thing or its shadow, is the only distinction the engine knows (section 5.4, the law of the bit). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no bit; the one kind of content stands, and the only distinction is between a quantum in flight, a shadow, and content held at a Node, matter (the orchestrator's reading). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.4 Matter is emergent

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray): a body is a measured event; the masses are the initialisation ([record 106](LOG_2026-09-20.md#106-decided-the-masses-and-charges-are-the-initialisation-the-catalog-of-the-families-not-derivable-in-this-law-the-two-sentences-superseded-the-binding-design-pending)); binding is the give at the contact ([record 143](LOG_2026-09-20.md#143-binding-v1-landed-pr-393-main-45c0eb48-the-physics-rule-review-mergeable-after-four-should-fix-none-blocking-the-rule-candidate-a-to-the-letter-and-every-pinned-integer-of-b1-b2-b3-reproduced-by-the-reviewers-own-replays-three-fixes-applied-before-the-merge-the-identity-and-given-from-the-run-time-give-the-designs-momentum-pin-outside-on-b1-by-270-720-on-x-exactly-6-x-3008-x-15-pushes-the-third-law-gap-of-record-126-made-visible-by-held-paid-content-that-counts-in-m_a-but-is-never-released-closed-once-both-gave-note-40s-readings-stated-b2s-amplitude-key-and-the-gate-replay-to-the-one-clicks-merge)).]*

**Research objective.** Particles, mass and the ordinary appearance of solid matter are intended to emerge as stable patterns of Node properties and their ray-form propagation and interactions. They are not additional fundamental substances. This is a research objective, not a claim that calibrated particle dynamics, mass or stable matter have already been derived. There is no matter in the model at this stage.

**Matter is a bound group.** Matter is the name for rays bound in one Node by a declared binding coupling (a neutron ray and a proton ray held together by the strong binding, an electron ray around them whose trajectory is changed at every step by the field rays the bound pair releases). Binding is the interaction whose result is zero events: the rays stay at the Node and interact again every interval. Mass is the retained energy of a bound group; the group's phase advance is its clock. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: matter is content held at a Node, the only place events happen, releasing shadows in proportion to its content and absorbing the whole quanta that reach it by its family's table (reading (i) there); whether bound contents exchanging quanta hold together and give the ladder is what round 8 must show. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Lifetime and unbinding.** A bound group has no lifetime of its own: it lasts as long as the binding interaction repeats at that Node without releasing an event. The binding may be nothing more than a very large output-clock delay (section 3.28) that the bound rays create together, a large mass making the Node very slow, so that the rays do not leave. It is unbound the same way anything else happens on the board: a ray arrives (a high-energy light ray, for instance; there is no photon, only a ray) and the coupling declared for the families present produces events that leave. Nothing else creates or destroys matter. Everything is the same generic ray with the same generic interaction, and everything follows from the generic transactions of the declared couplings; what remains is to close the binding couplings. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Binding is a periodic orbit of the meeting rule (model owner, 2026-09-17).** A ray never stops; "bound" does not mean "resident", it means "back at the same place in the same state". A bound group is a set of rays whose meetings, under the ordinary coupling table of section 5.2, reproduce the rays that entered them: the outputs leave, walk their Links, meet again, and the meeting gives the same amounts, the same phases modulo the circle and the same headings, so the pattern repeats forever; a pattern whose meeting does not close disperses. There is no binding rule: a bound group is a fixed point of the meeting table over a loop, and the only declared thing is the table. On the cubic lattice the smallest loop is a unit square of four Nodes with rays circulating both ways, each corner meeting every interval two rays that leave through each other's Ports; a group therefore lives on a ring of Nodes, not at one Node, its size is the ring, its clock is the period of the loop, and its mass is its content, exactly section 3.28. This is where the ladder of hypothesis 12 comes from: only the contents and phases that close a loop under the table exist, and experiment A10 counts them. Consequences: the field of a bound group is released by rays in motion, five headings each (section 3.5); the motion of a group as a whole must come from its loop, the corners shifting, not from a register on a Node; the held-ray binding of feature 8 (a rule with delay 1 and no outputs, and its ray_delay wait) is the interim form, which holds any content and therefore has no ladder, and the register-driven motion of feature 8c is the interim form of a group's motion; both are superseded by feature 14, binding as a loop, after features 12, 8c, 2b and 8b land. The two paragraphs above that speak of rays that stay at the Node describe the interim form. Since 2026-09-18 the field of a group is its shadow set, given with the board (section 5.4, "A thing does not emit"), and no ray releases per interval. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: nothing walks a path of its own, so no ray circulates on a ring; a bound group is contents held at Nodes exchanging whole quanta, and that this gives the ladder of hypothesis 12 is what round 8 must show; the field of a group is the shadows its held content releases every interval ("A thing emits"). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**What a field is.** A field is a local description of ray state, flux or interaction structure. It is not an additional material substance independent of the underlying rays. Every ray is the same ray; a field ray is not a second kind. A ray has a field: the field is the ray's own information spreading in ray form to the Nodes around it, without an event, and the field's presence at a Node is an interaction that makes no event. The field is released in all directions. Since 2026-09-18 (section 5.4) the field of a thing is its shadows, rays of its own family with bit 0 (point 12), given with the board ("A thing does not emit") and spreading by the Node's mixing (point 24); the release in all directions is the form before that date. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no bit; every ray is a shadow, released every interval by held content in proportion to its content ("A thing emits"), spreading by the Node's mixing, never disappearing, and leaving an open board only at its edge. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**When a field acts.** A field never makes an event unless it meets something it changes; the first event a field is involved in is that meeting, and the returning ray that carries the recoil is split off from it, like every ray from its event. Where a field ray meets a ray whose declared coupling responds, the meeting is an ordinary interaction and its events change that ray's trajectory; everywhere else the field crosses without an event. One of those events is the field ray itself returning reversed: the return is the opposite momentum of the field, carried back along the field ray's line to the ray that released it, which recoils when the return arrives, at finite speed. This is how section 3.14 is satisfied: the recoil is a ray. Until its field meets something, a traveling ray pays nothing for it. Sharpened on 2026-09-18 (the law of the bit, section 5.4): the recoil is the field ray itself turned back, its shadow returning on its own steps with its amount and the opposite of the momentum it gave, not a fresh ray that spreads on; the meeting creates no momentum, and what the ray it met gained, its source loses when the return arrives. Amended the same day (point 3): the return is a field, the shadow turned back with its heading reversed and its momentum inverted, mixing at every Node like any shadow, with no steps of its own; it is absorbed wherever it reaches its owner. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no return and no home; a shadow that reaches held content is absorbed as a whole quantum, the push being that quantum's momentum with the family's sign times the holder's cross-section, and the third law is the symmetry of the two fields, what escapes to the open edge carrying equal and opposite momenta (reading (ii) there). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**No self-field.** A ray traveling straight never meets its own field: the field is born where the ray is and leaves at the causal speed, ahead of the ray or away from it, and the ray is never faster than its field; no exclusion rule is needed. Only after a change of trajectory can a ray cross field it released earlier, and that is a meeting like any other. A ray's phase per step comes from its family rate alone (section 3.3), not from its own field. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: no ray travels straight, every ray spreads, and a held content sits in the field it releases; that a content in uniform motion absorbs no net momentum from its own field (inertia) is what round 8 must show. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**The release does not wait for the clock (model owner, 2026-09-17; superseded on 2026-09-18 by section 5.4, "A thing does not emit": there is no release per interval, the field is the standing set of shadows given with the board).** A field release is information, not a departure of matter: every interval, the content resident at a Node says in all six headings that it is there, with the strength its amount gives, and this is booked as a source; the Node's output clock delays only what leaves it as matter, never its field. So a heavy Node radiates every interval, its field is static and its strength grows with its content, as a mass at rest should; if the clock slowed the field too, a heavier body would radiate less. The engine's reading of the no-self-field rule (2026-09-17): a traveling ray releases in the five headings other than its own, because at one Link per interval a forward field ray would share its packet at every step, so the forward field of a ray at the speed of light is the ray itself; resident content releases in all six. On the lattice the field spreads as a diamond at the scale of Links and as a sphere at large scale, because the number of paths to a Node after k steps is the multinomial count, which is rotationally symmetric to leading order; whether the bending of a passing ray is the same on an axis and on a diagonal is a measurable prediction (experiment A6), not an assumption. Superseded again on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4, which restores the release per interval: held content says every interval that it is there, releasing shadows in proportion to its content ("A thing emits", reading (i) there); its release slows in a potential, which is the clock and the redshift (reading (iii)); the five-heading release of a traveling ray has no object, since no ray travels straight. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Light is the field, and the field spreads (model owner, 2026-09-17).** Light and the field of a charge are one family of the catalog, the electromagnetic field in ray form: a photon is one quantum of a field ray, an emission is a release of that family at an event, an absorption is a meeting of a field ray with a bound group (demonstrated 2026-09-17, examples/nature), and nothing distinguishes the field ray an electron releases from the light an atom emits but its amount, its phase and its event. Because light spreads, the field spreads by the same rule: every Node that field content reaches releases it again in all six headings by a declared split table, the remainder placed by section 3.17. This is Huygens' principle in the lattice's language, and it is one catalog entry of the family, not an engine mechanism. What follows from it, none of it inserted: the field of a static charge fills space; its density falls as 1/r, and the net momentum its rays carry through a Node, which is what a met ray feels, falls as 1/r², because the same flux crosses every shell (Gauss); the lattice's anisotropy is of higher order, and experiment A6 measures its residue; far from the source a whole quantum arrives only now and then, which is the photon; diffraction and the two slits need no rule of their own, a wall being a body that absorbs. The split must include the backward heading: a forward-only split piles the field on the diagonals and empties the axes. Field rays carry no event, so field content meeting at a Node combines by phase before it spreads, which is superposition and interference by the coherence rule of section 3.20. A single quantum cannot split; the shares the table gives a heading below one quantum are owned by the Node (section 3.17), kept per family and heading with their phase combined by the coherence rule, and leave as one whole quantum through that heading when they reach one, so the average intensities are exact and deterministic and a weak field reaches every Node in the end; a quantum may wait at a Node for that, while the front of a strong field still moves at the causal speed. The model owner chose this on 2026-09-17 over a phase-selected heading for the remainder, which the screen run of examples/nature (registered as E6) showed sends a single quantum along one fixed line and leaves every Node off the axis dark; the wave shows in intensities, and the Detector of section 5.4 decides where a quantum is realized; that is what experiment A1 confronts. The model owner's reading: this field, in whole quanta, spreading by one rule and read only by Detectors, is what physics calls the quantum field, and the photon is its quantum; a reading to be confronted by the runs, never a rule the engine uses. Until the split table exists the field lives on the six axis lines of its source and light goes straight; that is feature 12, field spreading, with its cost measured before adoption, since the field then fills the board (performance record). Superseded on 2026-09-18 by the law of the bit (section 5.4): there is no field family, a shadow is a ray of its owner's family with bit 0 and light emitted at an event is a thing of the light family (point 12); the split table is superseded by the Node's mixing (point 24); the remainder is a shadow parked at the Node (point 22); and the field is given with the board, not released at every Node ("A thing does not emit"). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: light is a shadow like every ray, a quantum of its family in flight, spreading by the Node's mixing and released by held content; a photon is the whole quantum made where the parked parts reach one, one absorption at one Node (reading (vi) there); light emitted at an event is no thing, and the field family stays retired. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**The field is matter's message about itself (model owner, 2026-09-17).** A field ray says "I am here": from which heading, how much, at what phase, and with which sign of charge; what happens to the ray that meets it is that ray's own table reading the message, so a force is how a ray reads the message of another (section 3.13). The message tells where its source was r intervals ago, since it travels at the causal speed, and it is not free: every field ray carries momentum and its source pays the recoil (section 3.14). A field ray is a ray with an empty event record, rest rate 0 and charge 0, and nothing else; that is why it merges by family and phase and spreads, and why nothing in the engine knows what a field is. The sign of the source's charge travels on the field ray as a visible property, like the Detector's bit, read by the coupling that meets it and never encoded in the phase, which is reserved for interference; feature 12 carries it and the catalog's open entry on the attraction of opposite charges closes with it (experiment A5). Since 2026-09-18 the message is the shadow: a ray of its owner's family with bit 0 that carries its owner's identity, charge and content, has no mass and no clock, is read by content or by charge (point 16), and returns as a field (point 3; section 5.4, definitions and points 12, 18). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no bit and no return; the message carries its last emitter's number and phase (reading (iv) there), and what a holder does with it is an absorption of a whole quantum, read by its content for gravity and its whole charge for electricity (reading (ii)). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.6 One underlying physics

Classical, quantum and field descriptions concern one modeled system of Node properties, events and Links, not separate material worlds. The Detector of section 3.19, a marked Node, is the only measurement mechanism within that description. A common framework and selected coupled experiments do not yet establish a complete derived unification of matter and fields.

**One ray, one catalog (model owner, 2026-09-17).** What today's unifications add up to: there is one kind of thing on the board, a ray, content in whole quanta with an amount, a phase, a heading and a family, moving one Link per interval; everything else is a name for a situation of rays. A family is a field: its free rays, spreading and combining by phase, are what physics calls the field, and one quantum of them is its particle in flight (a photon is one quantum of light; a free electron ray is one quantum of the electron field). Matter is a bound pattern of rays of a family (section 3.4), which is what physics calls the particle at rest, and its content is its mass and its clock (section 3.28). Light and the field of a charge are the same family (section 3.5); the electron and its own family's rays are the same thing; the electron and light are two families, coupled by charge, as the electron field and the photon field are in physics. A field ray is matter's message about itself, a force is how a ray reads the message of another, and every message is paid by recoil (sections 3.5, 3.13, 3.14). The catalog, the families with their properties and the couplings with their tables, is what the Lagrangian is in physics: the whole content of a theory; the engine is the one law that runs it, stepping, counting and dividing, and never knowing what an electron or a star is (section 5.2). The only draw is at a marked Node, every history begins and is realized at one, and the picture of the world is the list of PASS clicks (sections 3.19, 5.4). The model owner's reading is that this one ray, in whole quanta, is what physics calls the quantum field; the confrontation runs of section 6 test it, and the pieces borrowed from lattice gases, the Feynman checkerboard, path sums and the transactional reading are named in docs/EXPERIMENTS.md so that what is ours, the return through the event with its finite-speed price and the catalog as the whole theory, is tested and not assumed. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: one kind of ray still, the shadow; matter is content held at a Node, not a bound pattern of rays in motion; a particle in flight is a whole quantum where the parked parts reach one; there is no draw; and "what the eye sees is events", the model owner's words. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.7 Universal local laws

Equivalent local states with equivalent received inputs obey the same local rules, independent of position, total universe size or the labels assigned to an entity.

## 3.8 Causality has a finite speed

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray): no returning ray; a row crosses at most one Link per interval, the flight's rate against its denominator.]*

Ordinary physical propagation and transport cross adjacent Links at the finite causal speed bound c. A new event cannot instantaneously move stock, change a distant ordinary field or erase a remote path. A returning ray is ordinary propagation; it does not waive Node processing, output readiness or Link transit. Since 2026-09-18 (the evening, the law of the shadow, section 5.4) there is no returning ray; a change at held content reaches the world as the shadows it releases, one Link per interval. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.9 Fundamental propagation is local and stepwise

A physical ray advances only through connected neighboring Nodes. No physical trajectory may skip intermediate space.

## 3.11 Discrete physical state

*[Superseded on 2026-09-22 by [record 558](LOG_2026-09-20.md#558-the-owners-word-go-on-the-rename-to-working-bound-ordered-to-the-architect-and-far-2-2026-09-22-about-0000z-recorded-by-the-boss-at-2358z-the-owner-translated-go-on-the-rename-to-working-bound-the-decision-record-553s-offer-the-hosts-integer-bound-coreintegers-checked_work-is-the-working-bound-everywhere-it-is-named-the-word-register-names-the-detector-readings-alone-a-node-keeps-none-record-155-ordered-the-architect-session_01c7zob5at9snsegczqn6onq-after-his-far-worlds-item-branch-rename-working-bound-off-main-about-half-an-hour-documents-docstrings-and-comments-only-no-identifier-docsarchitecturemd-docsmigrationmd-with-one-line-naming-the-rename-docstest_expectationsmd-simulator_definitionsmd-docsbeam_lawmd-docsterminologymd-one-line-the-working-bound-never-called-a-register-srcevent_universecoreintegerpy-srcevent_universeeventsworldpy-teststest_integer_arithmeticpy-teststest_massive_rowspy-teststest_fraction_freepy-teststest_exact_phasepy-the-log-records-and-the-review-page-docsdesignsdoppler_v1review_2md-left-as-history-far-2-renames-the-two-files-he-holds-on-optical-v1-bresenham-srcevent_universeeventsnature_beampy-12-mentions-and-teststest_opticalpy-1-in-a-separate-small-commit-and-writes-the-working-bound-in-every-new-line-one-writer-per-file-one-highlights-line-added-by-the-boss-under-the-decisions-of-2026-09-21-the-owners-word-of-2026-09-22-0000z): signed bounded integers within the working bound, never a register (the mark below).]*

The adopted storage design uses bounded nonnegative integers, including zero, for values stored within a Node. Signed mathematical values require an explicit exact encoding; stored codes must not be confused with the values they represent. Ordinary core operations and their intermediates use bounded integers, without floating point, roots or trigonometry. The particular encoding is profile-specific; whether all working intermediates must also be nonnegative remains open. Superseded on 2026-09-22 by record 558 and the Beam Law's record (5.6): the integers are signed and bounded, a momentum component signed, the host's bound the working bound +-(2^63 - 1); the question of nonnegative intermediates is closed.

Each Node performs one bounded local update per tick using fixed-capacity channels, bounded payloads and identifiers, and six adjacent connections. Per-Node work and storage must not grow with world size or elapsed history. No growing queue, remote search or same-tick multi-Link push cascade is allowed. These are accepted requirements; their encounter implementation still needs verification. History storage and total host work are accounted separately.

## 3.13 Interactions create observable properties

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray) and on 2026-09-20 by [record 27](LOG_2026-09-20.md#27-decided-one-mechanism-for-all-the-laws-on-the-gameboard): the interaction is the push, one bilinear form over the columns, and the click.]*

Properties attributed to a particle are inferred from how the underlying ray pattern interacts. A name such as electron, proton or mass does not itself supply a physical law or a hidden value. Since 2026-09-18 (the evening, the law of the shadow, section 5.4) the interaction is an absorption: a whole quantum's momentum, with the family's sign, times the holder's cross-section, its content for gravity and its whole charge for electricity (reading (ii) there). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.14 No self-created force

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 10 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#10-i-approve-the-proposal-a-release-costs-the-emitter-e--h-f-the-two-gaps): the recoil is taken at the release and the books' momentum lines are exact at every interval; nothing returns.]*

An isolated closed physical structure cannot create net momentum from its own internal interactions. Local recoil is allowed only when an opposite momentum transfer is carried by rays or another explicitly owned local degree of freedom, so the total isolated system remains balanced. Since 2026-09-18 (the evening, the law of the shadow, section 5.4) the opposite momentum is carried by the field: the third law is the symmetry of the two fields, what escapes to the open edge carrying equal and opposite momenta, and momentum held, in flight and escaped is constant; nothing returns to its sender (reading (ii) there). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.15 Conservation is local accounting

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray): the ledger per family, measured, transit, content and charge lines, balanced at every interval (ENGINE); no return, no reconstruction.]*

**Exact accounting.** Whenever a quantity is declared conserved, every local interaction and transfer must account for it exactly across all actual owners, including retained participants, products, recoil, fields, apparatus, in-flight values and remainders. A gain requires a corresponding loss, transfer or explicitly accounted source. Family and coupling definitions supply the physical readouts; the engine validates them without inventing energy or momentum from a label or computation-cost scalar. Since 2026-09-18 (the law of the bit, section 5.4) the explicitly accounted source is the shadows alone: things conserve amount, momentum and charge among themselves exactly, with no source line, and only a released field, which is never realized, is booked as sourced; a thing and the shadows it has in flight are its presence. The same day ("A thing does not emit", point 7): the shadows are initial content given with the board, so no line is sourced at all and the books are kept per bit. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there are no things; the books keep one line for held content and one for the shadows, with the shadows' emission, escaped and absorbed, and momentum held, in flight and escaped is constant at every interval (the glossary of the law of the shadow, *Books*). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Why: reconstruction.** The conservation laws stay in force everywhere; they are the condition of reconstruction. Every declared invariant is exact across an interaction so that the event can be rebuilt from its pieces when they return. A ray returning from a Detector holds its event in order to reconstruct it, its momentum and everything that was there; without that, a return would erase events. A Detector that returns a ray is returning an event in time, undoing it by exactly what that piece carried. Exact integer arithmetic is what makes the undoing exact. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: no ray returns from a mark and no event is undone; the invariants stay exact at every absorption and release, and the reconstruction has no object (the orchestrator's reading). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.16 Momentum is directional

Momentum and other vector quantities are conserved component by component. Preserving only speed or vector magnitude is not sufficient.

## 3.17 Remainders are physical bookkeeping

*[Superseded on 2026-09-20 by [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception): every count an accumulator on the body's record with its remainder kept (the mark below).]*

Discrete division or allocation must not silently destroy information or conserved quantity. Every indivisible remainder has an explicit bounded owner and lifecycle. An overflow or unsupported numerical representation rejects the operation before mutation; it must not silently round, clamp or drop an owner. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: at a Node nothing is left over to own; where a ratio leaves less than a whole for a side, the whole goes to one side by the conservations of the cell in the same interval, and no share or count waits. The rule stands for the host's bookkeeping outside the physics.) Superseded on 2026-09-20 by record 155, the fraction-free law (marked 2026-09-22): every count is an accumulator on the body's record with its remainder kept and never discarded at run time, nothing at a Node; the rule stands for the host's bookkeeping.

**The mark.** A measurement is an interaction at a Node whose Detector bit is set. Every Node carries one bit, Detector or not; the mark is bounded Node metadata (bit, setting, ticket seed), not a record and not an external device, and Detector behavior is how a Node behaves when the bit is set. A source is a Detector: whatever emits a ray of a known family is a marked Node, because knowing the family of what it emits is a measurement. The birth event of a pair therefore happens at a marked Node, which draws on every arrival like any other. Since 2026-09-18 the mark has no seed and draws nothing (section 5.4, point 14): it absorbs a thing by its declared table and returns a shadow (point 6). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: a mark is held content with a table that counts; it absorbs the whole quanta that reach it and returns nothing, and "events are created only at a detector", the model owner's words; a source is a lamp, held content that releases light, spending its content. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**The draw.** A marked Node does one very simple thing. What arrives is a wave ray carrying information; every ray is a wave ray, so the kind makes no difference. For each transfer that arrives, whatever it is, it draws 1 or 0, the only lottery in the model. Up to six transfers can arrive in one interval, one per Port, and the Node draws once for each, independently: the arrivals that drew 1 enter the ordinary interaction together, each arrival that drew 0 is returned on its own line. It reads, changes, absorbs and adds nothing. A Detector sees nothing of the ray, on 1 or on 0: it sees only its own value. Superseded on 2026-09-18 by the law of the bit (section 5.4): the kind does make the difference, and it is written on the ray at birth; a marked Node returns a shadow without a draw and absorbs a thing, the draw deciding only whether the mark caught it (its efficiency) or missed it and sent it back. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: no kind is written at birth, since every ray is a shadow; "an event is created when measuring", a whole quantum changing state at the mark's Node, and what the mark does not know in advance is whether a whole quantum is made there (the orchestrator's reading). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**1, the measurement.** On 1 the Node behaves as an ordinary Node for that arrival and the transfer continues or interacts. A measurement exists only when the Node drew 1 and let the ray pass; the click is the record of that 1. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no 1; the measurement is an absorption of a whole quantum at the mark's held content, and the click is its record. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**0, no measurement.** On 0 the Node returns that wave ray on the same line in the opposite direction, unchanged, back the same number of steps it has made since its event, so that it arrives at the Node it left from with exactly the information it left with. On 0 there is no measurement: the Node returns the ray without touching it and is a Node without measurement, as if the ray had not arrived, and it waits for what the return brings back. When it returned a ray with 0, that value travels with the ray, and the second Detector of the pair receives it on the ray that reaches it. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (section 5.4, points 3 and 6): a mark returns a shadow as any thing does, the shadow turned back with its heading reversed and its momentum inverted, a field from then on with no step count; what a mark that misses a thing does is point 6. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no 0 and no return of any kind, there being no return and no home (reading (ii) there). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Nothing else samples.** Ordinary Node creation, propagation, interactions and emissions do not sample. A passive Recorder or Renderer does not perform a measurement or acquire sampling authority. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**The external body (model owner, 2026-09-17; named "fixed body" earlier that day).** Beside the Detector there is one more marked element of a world, and like the Detector it is a declaration, not physics: an external body, a Node declared to hold a family with an amount and, if wanted, a charge, standing for a star, a neutron star, a fixed proton, a large charge, or a piece of apparatus. What is declared: the family, the amount (finite, of any width, since it enters no sum; it only sets how much field leaves per interval), the charge, and an initial momentum (a heading and a pace, zero for a body at rest). What it does: it radiates exactly as any bound group does, by the one field rule of section 3.5 and with the strength its amount gives, so its gravity and its electric field are the ordinary field rays of the model and every ray that meets them responds by its declared coupling. What it does not do: it does not spread, which is its defining property: it never splits, binds, unbinds, converts or decays, and its whole content stays at one Node; and it is not pushed by matter: whatever arrives at it, a recoil field ray or a ray that couples to it, is met by the declared coupling of its family, and the body's content never changes. Absorption into an explicitly accounted sink is the default coupling, and the other couplings make the apparatus: a reversed heading is a mirror, a split by a declared table is a beam splitter, a phase offset is a phase plate, a polarization read is a polarizer once feature 11 exists; a wall, a screen and a beam stop are the default. Its motion is caused by fields only (model owner, 2026-09-17): it starts with its declared momentum, an arriving field ray of a family its coupling table names changes that momentum by the table, and nothing else moves it, since matter that arrives is absorbed without a push; its velocity is its momentum over its amount, kept as an exact accumulator that steps one Link when a full amount has accumulated on an axis, so against an electron it stands still while two stars turn each other over long times; and wherever it is, the Node it is at holds all of it. The audit carries the bodies' momentum as its own line, so momentum stays exact when a field ray is absorbed. The audit books what it radiates as a source and what it absorbs as a sink, so conservation stays exact at every tick. On the Node it is bounded metadata like the Detector mark: the kind of mark, the declaration, and one exact counter (the sink totals per family); no rays, no history. In the Node's law it is one flag: spreading is not enforced for this Node's content, and every other step of the law (the arrivals, the couplings by table, the stamping, the departures of what leaves) is unchanged. That flag is also why it has no ladder of masses: the ladder of hypothesis 12 comes from the spreading law, since a bound group is rays that must keep moving and bind again every interval, so only the closed patterns the binding table can hold exist; a body that does not spread has no closure condition and any amount is allowed. In a rendering every external body carries its own identifying picture (a star, a mirror, a wall), so it is never mistaken for matter. When the back-reaction is wanted, a star that recoils or a proton that moves, the body is not used: the same thing is declared as an ordinary bound group with a large amount, and then it spreads and is pushed like all matter. The external body is the approximation of infinite mass, used for the confrontation runs: light bending by a star, an electron near a large charge, a hydrogen-like spectrum around a fixed proton, and the two-slit and Bell geometries with their walls, mirrors and splitters. Since 2026-09-18 (section 5.4, point 22 and the settled rule (v)) the external body is a thing with declared tables like every apparatus: its shadows are given with the board, it radiates nothing per interval, and nothing it does is sourced ("A thing does not emit", point 7). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: the external body is held content, one of matter's two forms with the mark's counter (reading (i) there); it releases shadows every interval in proportion to its content ("A thing emits"), absorbs the whole quanta that reach it by its table, and nothing of it is given with the board. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Alternatives.** Outside a Detector every trajectory an interaction permits actually happens; determinism does not select one classical trajectory. A new ordinary event does not authorize sampling. The 1-or-0 draw at a marked Node is the measurement itself (since 2026-09-18 no mark draws: a mark absorbs a thing and returns a shadow, and what it "draws" is which of the two arrived, section 5.4, point 14). Replaying one committed Detector decision returns the same result without another draw, emission or inventory charge. Later calculation must preserve recorded history, not rewrite the past. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: the measurement is an event, a whole quantum changing state at a Node that holds content; no mark draws, and nothing arrives as a thing or as its shadow, every ray being a shadow. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Everything is information on rays.** Everything on the board is a transfer of information. An event is a splitting of information: each ray carries its own share of what happened at the event away from it. All the information is on the rays; the origin Node keeps nothing, and there is no register. Every ray carries the information of the last event it was involved in. If that event was at a Detector, the ray records that it was a Detector event and the bit drawn, 1 or 0; the bit is all the Detector adds. An event cannot be moved; there is no such thing. It happened at its Node, and a returning ray walks back exactly the number of steps it has made to reach it (for a shadow, superseded on 2026-09-18: its return is a field and walks nothing back, section 5.4, point 3). Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no bit and no walk back; a ray carries its family, its amount, its phase, its heading and its last emitter's number (reading (iv) there; the orchestrator's reading of the list), and nothing walks a path of its own. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Entanglement is the name for siblings of one event (2026-09-17).** Rays that left the same last event carry the same record of it, and nothing reads that record until a Detector; that shared record, and the trajectory back to the event, are all there is to entanglement. Nothing else is shared: no register, no state at a distance. A Detector that draws 1 realizes its ray; a Detector that draws 0 returns it, and the returning ray delivers what it carries to the sibling lines through the event (section 5.4). Whatever happens between an event and the first PASS is therefore a correlated set of rays, and PASS is the only thing that ends it. An ordinary meeting on the way is itself an event: its outputs are new siblings of that new event, and each ray's siblings are always those of its own last event. The earlier correlation is not lost: the transmission from a return chases the share through the later event by the rule above, which is how correlation passes from one pair to another without any rule for it. The price of section 5.4 applies to every such set. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: no return delivers anything through the event and nothing chases a share; "Bell measures an event": two events of one field at two places, each born of the local field and the local setting, at most 2 (reading (vii) there); what the siblings of one event are, when nothing walks a path, is to be restated by round 8. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**A return is the inverse split.** A ray that meets a Detector is not obliged to return; the Detector may continue it as usual (1). A return (0) turns time back for that ray's share only: the returning ray carries what happened at the event, and at the event Node it performs the inverse split with its information, transmitting it to the same places the event sent to, so that it cancels what was already there and the momentum and energy of that share are restored exactly. A ray that passes is realized. Sibling events of one interaction are independent rays, each meeting its own fate; the other shares are untouched until their own rays return. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no return and no inverse split; an absorbed quantum is held or released again by the family's table, and nothing is undone. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**The transmission is a ray.** The transmission is a ray like any other, with a field like any other: it cancels the share only where it meets it, and where it meets nothing it makes no event, by the same definitions. A share that left the event earlier on a straight line at the same speed is met only where it was delayed: bound at a Node, slowed by an output clock, changed by an interaction or standing at a Detector; for a pair this is the condition stated in section 5.4. Even when it is never caught, the event as it was has changed: the returned ray reversed its share, so the event lost that share, and the information is never lost, it chases the share it cancels. If the share is delayed and caught, momentum and everything else are conserved at the Node where they meet. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no transmission and no chase; every ray is a shadow released by held content. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Return modes.** What a returning ray does at its event Node when nothing is there is a configured mode of the world, three of which are defined and tested: siblings, the default and the rule above (it transmits its share and bit to every line the event sent to, which needs at most six records on the ray, one per Port); straight (it continues straight through the Node on the one line opposite its own, enough for a pair, with no records); and annul (it ends there, its content leaves the world into an explicitly accounted sink, initial equals current plus escaped plus annulled at every tick, and its information survives only in the record). If something is at the Node, a bound group or other rays, the returning ray meets it by the declared coupling in every mode. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no return, so no mode; the three modes describe the old engine, kept beside feature 20 until the new one has repeated every confrontation. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.21 Emergence, not insertion

Large-scale laws must be derived from repeated local interactions. The desired macroscopic equation must not be inserted directly into the elementary update rule.

## 3.22 Scale independence

The same elementary laws apply in small test regions and in larger universes. Increasing the simulated size may add more Nodes and events, but it must not change the underlying local physics.

## 3.23 Symmetry is a requirement

Equivalent experiments under allowed shifts, orientations and other relevant transformations should produce equivalent physical behavior, subject only to genuine lattice effects that must be measured rather than hidden.

## 3.24 Geometry is relational

Spatial geometry is determined by the network of local connections and their propagation structure. Global coordinates are useful descriptions, not information required by local physics.

## 3.25 Complexity is emergent

Complex structures, apparent particles, material behavior and macroscopic laws must arise from repeated simple interactions among rays in local discrete space.
