Known symmetry groups and their representations constrain how property vectors transform and which couplings are allowed. A mathematical group is not a collection of moving objects: collections are interacting or correlated Node degrees of freedom whose propagation takes ray form. Families such as quarks are represented by property sectors; strong and weak interactions are operations on those sectors. Generic definitions must specify the local participants, transformations, conserved quantities and output channels, rather than infer a law from an entity or interaction name.

**Forces and polarization are catalog entries, not engine mechanisms (approved 2026-09-17).** The engine performs only the simple operations: a step on a Link, a phase advance, a split by a declared table, a sum, and the one draw at a marked Node. Anything that does not change how a ray moves between events is therefore a family property in the catalog or a coupling table, read only at a meeting, exactly as charge is. Polarization is such a property: a transverse mode perpendicular to the heading, two states for light (the two lattice axes perpendicular to an axial heading) and two for the electron family (spin), read by the declared couplings at a meeting; a circular polarization is not defined and, if wanted, would be a transverse direction that turns with the phase plus one handedness bit, again a catalog choice. Pauli exclusion is a binding coupling that does not fire for two electrons in the same state with the same spin. Polarization is feature 11, after the ten features of the ray-event migration; none of them needs it, and the Bell prediction of hypothesis 11 is testable without it in its phase form. The gluon is a real ray (model owner, 2026-09-18, under the law of the bit): there is no field family, so the strong field of a quark is the quark's own shadows (section 5.4, point 12), and the gluon is a family of things, bit 1, emitted at events as light is, differing from light in that it carries colour charge and so is itself pushed; the string, confinement and hadronization below are read with the gluon as a thing family and the field as the quarks' shadows, and the catalog's `gluon` entry as a field family is retired. The strong interaction is the same pattern: quark families, colour a property with three values, the gluon the quark's own field in ray form (section 3.5), the binding of three quarks a binding coupling (section 3.4); its short range and its growth with distance are expected from one more declared coupling, the quark's field rays binding to each other, and whether that yields confinement is a research question, not an engine decision. The weak interaction is a change of family: an N-to-M conversion at an event with its declared invariants (charge, energy, momentum). A free particle never decays, because there is no event without a meeting and a straight ray does not change; a neutron is a bound group whose ticks are events, and a bound group that can decay is a source, and a source is a Detector (section 3.19): at each tick it draws with its declared ratio as the setting, 1 = the conversion fires, 0 = the group ticks on unchanged, so half-life follows and nothing else in the world draws (superseded on 2026-09-18 by section 5.4, point 20: a decay is a table on the group's own state, and nothing draws). None of this adds anything to the engine; all of it comes after feature 10. In the language of binding as a loop (section 3.4, 2026-09-17): the strong field differs from light by one catalog line, its rays couple to each other, so the field between quarks does not spread as a sphere but closes into loops of gluon rays along the line between them, a string whose content, and so whose mass, grows with the distance; only colour-neutral patterns close a loop, which is confinement as a closure condition; and a string stretched to the content at which a new loop closes with a quark and an antiquark breaks into two hadrons, which is hadronization. None of this is inserted; hypothesis 13 says whether the two catalog lines produce it, in a research run after feature 14. Superseded on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: there is no thing ray, so the gluon, like light, is a quantum of its family in flight, a shadow (the orchestrator's reading); a mark draws nothing, as before; the string, confinement, hadronization and the decay table are to be restated by round 8. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

## 3.27 Generic laws, symmetry and vector operations define board events

The design chain is: generic schema → symmetry requirements → scalar/vector and matrix operations → events and Links in our spacetime. The same local rule applies to equivalent resident states and arrived inputs. Under allowed lattice transformations S, require F(SX, SI) = S F(X, I), or the corresponding equality of outcome distributions. A directed propagation pattern may break state symmetry without breaking law symmetry; generic code alone does not establish symmetry. Every proposed rule must identify where state is stored, what arrived, what operation acts, whether an outcome is recorded, how long it takes and what crosses each Link.

**Superseded on 2026-09-18 (section 5.4, points 9, 16, 21, 22 and 23).** Every ray moves one Link per interval and a thing delays nothing; no output clock delays a departure, and the lag register leaves the model with the word register. Gravity is the push of the shadows read times the content of what is pushed (point 16); the only wait is the tick a thing pays for every whole quantum it reads (point 23), and the bending beyond Newton's comes from that wait. The paragraphs of this section describe the interim form. Superseded again on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow, section 5.4: gravity is the absorption of whole quanta, their momentum with the family's sign, gravity's toward the source, times the holder's content (reading (ii) there); the wait reads the size and is paid by every quantum, held or in flight, so a held content's release slows in a potential, the clock and the redshift, and light in flight steps slower where the size is larger, an index n = 1 + 2GM/r, the bending and the Shapiro delay whole (reading (iii)). (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

The computation field is a Node property that propagates in ray form through ordinary neighboring Links, not an external scheduler instruction or additional substance. Once causally received, it may affect output timing through the declared local family rule. Each Node has six independent output-face clocks and no input clock delay. A split or emitted branch waits for its own output-face readiness; equal face values do not turn these into one shared Node clock. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

```text
tau_out(v,d) = k_out(v,d) * delta_t_min; d in {+x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z}
```

The bounded integer output count k_out is supplied by a declared local family/profile rule, including its application time and pending-output policy. Fixed neighboring Link transit H is separate: total travel time is the output delay plus H, without an input delay, double counting or same-tick multi-Link relay. Symmetry-equivalent inputs and directions require equivalent timing. Neither host CPU load nor a rest-phase formula defines this delay. Field transport, emission funding and remainders retain the same explicit ownership as other properties. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Gravity is bending by delay.** The computation field obeys the one field rule of section 3.5, with no rule of its own: the retained content of a Node (its mass, section 3.4) is what makes it slow, and the information that a Node is heavy spreads from it in ray form in all directions. Where such a field ray meets a ray whose declared coupling responds, there is an event with two effects: the ray that was met is delayed (its output clock grows, the action of this section), and the field ray returns reversed to the heavy Node. The delay is larger on the side nearer the heavy Node, so the ray bends toward it; that bending is a change of momentum, and the returning field ray carries the opposite momentum back to the heavy Node, which is drawn toward the ray. Gravity is this bending by delay; it is not inserted as a force, nothing is absorbed, and momentum is exact. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

**Speed is a clock slowing (model owner, 2026-09-17).** Everything on the board moves at one Link per interval; there is no other speed in the engine. Matter is slower only because the output clock of its bound group delays its departures: a group that moves one Link every k intervals has speed 1/k in units of c, and light, with delay 0, has c. Three things slow a clock, and all three are content meeting content by a declared table: the content retained at the Node itself (the group's own mass), the field of another mass that a ray meets (gravity, the paragraph above), and a declared interaction whose output assigns a delay (binding among them). Nothing slows a clock because of motion: there is no kinematic rule, and the slower ticking of a moving group, if it appears, must emerge from its rays spending intervals on Links instead of resident (hypothesis 15, experiment A14). This is why mass, time dilation and gravity are one bookkeeping of integer delays read from different tables, and why the tables, not the engine, are what the confrontation runs test. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.) Read on 2026-09-22 with records 687 and 749: on the board no clock slows by motion (stage 1's verdict); a moving detector's slowing is Outside, the click theorem's rate under its second assumption, which the law's rows do not yet meet.

**The phase circle stays small; a fine delay is a register, not a wide phase (2026-09-17, decided by the orchestrator on the model owner's delegation).** A family's phase is read only at a meeting, and only as a difference: the coherence table and the Born coupling read the difference of two phases, never a phase alone. So the width `phase_bits` is a choice of the family for the resolution its couplings need: eight steps resolve the Born table, and a wider circle is allowed but never required. The weakness of gravity does not live in the phase. The delay a field ray lays on the ray it meets is carried in a lag register with its own declared modulus, spent one Link toward the lagging side when it reaches that modulus, exactly as a heading is carried with a resolution of one part in 2^30 through six Ports; the modulus of the lag, not the phase circle, is the N of hypothesis 14, and it may be of any width because it enters no phase sum. The external body removed the need for a wide phase on the side of the source, since its mass is its amount (section 3.19); the lag register removes it on the side of the met ray. Consequences: the 75-bit phase of experiment A11 remains a check that the width leaks into no coupling, and nothing on the road to the confrontation runs needs it; the lag of feature 8, counted today in phase steps, is reworked to its own modulus as feature 8b, after feature 10; and the transition tables planned in the performance record keep one small phase dimension per meeting and carry the lag outside the key. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

What an observer sees is a representation of the same underlying Node states and events, determined by the observer's reference frame, orientation, motion and measurement interaction. Observable records arise only from information that has causally reached the measuring system, not from an instantaneous view of the whole board.

```text
observed_description = Transform_frame(Readout(local_measurement_records))
```

Changing coordinates or basis changes an event's description; a measurement interaction may change state and record an outcome. These are distinct operations. Equivalent descriptions preserve declared invariants and consistent records. The Detector is a marked Node on the board (section 3.19), not an external device; it acts on what arrives through its Ports, on the board clock. A material eye or observer emerging on the board is a research goal, not a completed implementation. Detector, passive Recorder and Renderer remain distinct; a global audit display is not a physical observer. Superseded on 2026-09-19 by the Beam Law (marked 2026-09-22): a detector is a declared set of measured events, an external entity of the world file (5.4, records 28 of 2026-09-19 and 562); what is observed is the clicks Outside (record 768).

no draw; what a detector reads is the readings by type.]*

The purpose of Universe24 is to turn abstract mathematical descriptions of groups, representations, particle families and their properties into explicit board dynamics and, through a modeled detector, observable experience. Abstract does not mean imaginary. The engine uses one generic state schema and operation framework: fields, electrons, muons and gluons are distinguished by property content, representations and permitted interactions, not by separate fundamental engines. A ray is the propagation form of these properties, not an additional entity class. Uniform representation must retain physical differences, including charges, spin, statistics and couplings.

```text
property definitions + symmetry representations → Node state → propagation and interaction → detector records → observer-dependent display
```

At each Node, separately implemented generic operations evaluate owned properties and arrived inputs under immutable family/coupling definitions. The engine schedules, transports and validates; NodeState stores bounded data rather than physical formulas or executable expressions. Ordinary evolution is deterministic, while only a Node whose Detector bit is set draws (no draw since 2026-09-18, section 5.4, point 14). A Recorder stores evidence and a Renderer presents it. The material-eye and full species-dynamics goals remain separate from supported profiles; a visualization does not establish agreement with nature. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

# 4. Central statement

*[Superseded on 2026-09-19 by [record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray): the Beam Law; the statement of the system today is section 1, 'The system on 2026-09-22'.]*

Universe24 investigates one discrete Node-and-Link world in which properties propagate in ray form and matter, particles and mass are intended to emerge as stable patterns. Ordinary dynamics are local and deterministic; the only draw is at a Node whose Detector bit is set (no draw since 2026-09-18, section 5.4, point 14), and there is no shared resource, no hidden ordinary access and no second material world. Symmetry representations constrain generic property operations. Every mechanism must specify local state, arrivals, operations, owners, output clocks and causal transfers. The aim is to derive and test effective behavior without inserting the desired macroscopic laws. A defined contract or configured experiment is not yet a complete derived theory of nature. (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: read as section 5.4's law of events says, there being no ray, thing, shadow or bit, no draw and no return; what this describes is an event, in transit or measured, handled by the Node's one computation, and a Node keeps nothing.)

# 5. Reading map

## 5.1 Node state and ray form

Written again on 2026-09-22; the text as it stood is in [section 10](#10-the-head-and-the-reading-map-before-2026-09-22-history).

**The location.** A Node is one location of the GameBoard, six Ports in Port order and a Link to each neighbour; its NodeState is all the local information it owns at an interval, the records of the rows present and of the body there, and nothing else: no wave, no lane, no slot, no parked share, no register ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception); [TERMINOLOGY, the location](TERMINOLOGY.md#the-location)). The GameBoard's translation group Z_X x Z_Y x Z_Z acts by shift operators, and the 48 signed axis permutations about a Node (24 rotations, 24 reflections, told apart by the hand) are the symmetry every rule is covariant under up to the two declared ties ([record **The row.** `NatureBeam`, the record of an event in transit, one row per record in the store: its Node, its direction (0 and 1 the rest directions, 2 to 7 the six headings in Port order, 8 onward the declared primitive vectors within the bound P), its age since the event that created it, kept whole, its phase on the circle Z_N stamped by the emitter's clock at birth and turned by its family's `phase_per_link` at every Link, its number (the last emitter's), its amount and its content per unit (h x s for a paid family, 0 for a free one); its momentum is not stored but is its label, content x **u**_d per unit along the unit vector of its direction at the scale Q = 64, and its hand is a pseudoscalar carried unchanged ([BEAM_LAW section 2](BEAM_LAW.md#2-the-record-of-a-ray-and-the-world-file), notes 18, 23, 25, 39). In a recorded world it carries its record's number, its branch and its multiplicity, and rows of one record in antiphase cancel at the merge (note 37). A row is a body of no content: the first test.

**The body.** A measured event, created here without end, at one Node or on a set of Nodes (`span`): its held content per family (its content the sum, its charge per column the rational sum over what it holds), its momentum vector **p** in label units, its phase, its clock (the count of its self-creations, its age) and its counts table, one row per count with one bounded accumulator each, the owed count, the release per family, the lamp's wheel, the turn, the push per column and axis, the drive, the action and the place rows; every count is the whole part its accumulator yields against its denominator and the remainder stays on the record ([BEAM_LAW section 5](BEAM_LAW.md#5-the-detectors-record-the-re-emission-the-face-detectors), notes 31, 41, 46; [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception), [record 180](LOG_2026-09-20.md#180-the-wheel-as-the-generic-vector-form-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0105z-the-owners-words-translated-the-wheel-was-also-turned-into-a-generic-vector-wasnt-it-the-bosss-yes-taken-as-the-decision-on-record-163-3-the-birth-wheel-is-one-row-of-the-counts-table-on-the-lamps-record-acc--2531-acc-mod-4096-the-translation-on-the-torus-z--4096-that-every-count-is-the-lamp-writes-the-rows-value-on-the-record-at-birth-as-u-at-the-click-the-cells-cumulative-weights-are-sums-the-rungs-2-w-c_k--t--2-t-one-declared-rounding-and-the-choice-u--b_k-the-wall-test-so-the-whole-click-is-a-multiplication-by-declared-matrices-an-addition-an-inner-product-and-a-threshold-no-step-of-its-own-the-map-record-164-showed-the-same-clicks-as-the-bit-reversed-ordinal-within-one-click-at-4096-births-physically-the-lamps-phase-at-the-moment-of-birth-at-a-rate-incommensurate-with-its-birth-rate-built-as-item-3-of-the-click-pull-request-after-the-exact-phase)). A body moves by its momentum, one Link per self-creation at most; a fixed body never steps and takes every push into its momentum; a body is an emitter (a lamp, a release) and a detector at its own Node ([record 569](LOG_2026-09-20.md#569-the-owners-word-an-emitter-behaves-as-a-detector-too-within-its-limits-a-fixed-body-is-both-2026-09-22-about-0014z-recorded-by-the-boss-the-reviewers-question-of-record-567-a-fixed-body-without-a-lamp-both-self-creates-rays-an-emitter-and-reads-what-arrives-a-detector-put-to-the-owner-with-the-bosss-proposed-answer-both-by-the-role-of-each-act-the-owner-translated-yes-an-emitter-behaves-like-a-detector-right-with-its-limitations-the-decision-every-external-entity-is-a-detector-or-an-emitter-and-an-emitter-is-also-a-detector-at-its-own-node-within-its-limits-it-reads-only-what-arrives-at-it-the-clicks-at-its-node-or-faces-its-declared-reads-such-as-age-never-a-store-elsewhere-what-it-emits-is-an-emitters-act-what-it-reads-is-a-detectors-reading-and-a-fixed-body-is-both-the-registers-labels-of-a-bodys-clock-and-momentum-as-detector-readings-stand-enginemds-table-one-highlights-line-added-extending-the-line-of-record-562-the-reviewers-question-is-closed-by-this-word-no-file-of-the-register-changes-for-it)).

**The record of a quantum.** In a recorded world, the identity a lamp's self-creation gives every row it births, carried through every split, re-emission, rotation and gate; one record is one quantum of the world's list of clicks, its rows its paths, its click one; in the vector form the record is the phase-count vector **f** of Z^N per end Node and label, an element of the group ring Z[Z_N] ([record 86](LOG_2026-09-20.md#86-decided-amplitude-v1-is-built-with-the-four-recommendations-and-the-four-unifications), [record 188](LOG_2026-09-20.md#188-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0140z-the-owners-words-translated-yes-if-it-cleans-a-non-vector-operation-off-the-gameboard-the-click-without-amplitudes-on-the-bosss-answer-to-the-owners-question-is-there-a-vector-operation-that-replaces-the-amplitudes-the-record-is-the-phase-count-vector-f-in-zn-the-amplitude-x-y--e-f-with-e-the-2-x-n-matrix-of-the-rounded-cosine-and-sine-rows-the-weight-x2--y2--ft-g-f-with-g--et-e-the-gram-matrix-one-bilinear-form-on-the-record-bit-identical-by-the-associativity-of-integer-arithmetic-the-arms-products-bell-ghz-the-multiplication-in-the-group-ring-zz_n-a-convolution-and-the-label-rotation-the-same-in-zz_2n-the-coherent-sum-within-a-node-tuple-and-the-incoherent-sum-across-tuples-one-block-diagonal-g-so-the-click-is-convolutions-and-additions-in-the-ring-one-bilinear-form-and-one-threshold-and-the-complex-numbers-zi-cmul-leave-the-code-the-form-is-the-lattice-gleasons-at-c_1--1-record-185-the-host-cost-n2-per-cell-for-2-n-the-owners-yes-conditional-on-the-change-removing-a-non-vector-operation-from-the-gameboard-which-it-does-the-evaluation-into-zi-and-the-complex-product-are-replaced-by-the-rings-convolution-and-the-one-bilinear-form-built-as-item-1b-of-the-click-pull-request-by-the-click-implementer-bit-identical-no-re-registration-the-derivation-mathematicians-67-ordered-before-the-decision-proves-the-identity-and-checks-it-integer-by-integer-on-mz_equal-slits_low-and-the-bell-cells-the-owners-question-of-the-same-message-what-is-the-input-of-the-whole-story-the-mass-n-and-g-and-something-else-what-is-our-input-to-our-physical-world-and-what-is-the-input-to-the-real-world-answered-in-record-189); BEAM_LAW note 37).

**The store and the books.** The host's arrays, one row per record per family, sorted by Node at every interval, and the ledger per family exact at every interval (the measured, transit, content and charge lines and the momentum held, in transit, escaped and turned); both are the host's reports, GAMEBOARD, never a thing of the law ([BEAM_LAW section 3](BEAM_LAW.md#3-the-nodes-interval-nature_beam); [ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md)).

**The families in place of layers.** What the older text called a layer is the family table: families a body's table does not name pass it (`pass`), the crowd a reader reads is everything at its Node but its own number, and a row of one family meets a body only through that body's entry for the family ([record 18 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#18-i-approve-1-and-3-and-2-with-the-physicist); ## 5.2 Generic operations at a Node

Written again on 2026-09-22; the text as it stood is in [section 10](#10-the-head-and-the-reading-map-before-2026-09-22-history).

**The interval.** One function, `nature_beam`, performs a Node's whole interval for the rows present, in six named steps and nothing else with law in it ([BEAM_LAW, "The owner's name"](BEAM_LAW.md#the-beam-law-beam-v1); [section 3](BEAM_LAW.md#3-the-nodes-interval-nature_beam)): (1) `_walk`, departures become arrivals, every row whose flight counts a Link crosses it whole, its record unchanged, the row and the body meeting once at the crossing of their world lines ([record 158](LOG_2026-09-20.md#158-the-crossing-rule-designed-record-153s-order-the-physicist-read-only-scratchpad-crossingdesignmd-with-crossing_simpy-main-unchanged-a-row-and-a-body-meet-once-at-the-crossing-of-their-world-lines-a-body-at-rest-reads-arrivals-as-today-in-the-interval-of-a-step-it-also-meets-the-rows-that-crossed-its-own-link-the-other-way-and-the-rows-resident-at-the-destination-moving-against-it-and-it-does-not-meet-the-rows-moving-with-it-the-rows-behind-it-on-its-link-or-one-interval-later-the-rows-it-met-at-the-origin-the-leapfrog-the-bodys-own-two-last-links-are-the-only-facts-nothing-at-a-node-proved-on-the-experimenters-streams-toward-k--4-45-reads-in-32-intervals-k--8-58-in-48-away-19-in-32-38-in-48-rest-48-no-row-twice-none-missed-the-integer-form-moves-_move-before-the-law-and-makes-met-the-crossing-expression-doppler-v1-and-g-deleted-with-the-list-the-emergent-doppler-exact-on-the-axis-and-the-transverse-an-encounter-count-on-a-fan-direction-a-limit-to-state-not-to-tune-admissible), note 48); (2) `_collide`, at a Node of free space the permutation of the directions of the single rows of one (Node, number, content) group by the eight-slot table, a bijection ([section 4](BEAM_LAW.md#4-the-collision-table)); (3) `_measure`, every body reads the one reading set at its Nodes (the amount-weighted moments of order 0, 1 and 2 of the arrivals' unit vectors and the age moment) and applies its table per family, `read` (the push taken, the rows go on), `measure` (the click), `rerelease` (taken, to be created again), `pass`, or `become` (the transformation, `weak-v1`); (4) `_release`, at a self-creation a body releases what its table and its lamp say, every unit priced by the turn, E = h f, apportioned whole over its directions with the recoil taken ([record 10 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#10-i-approve-the-proposal-a-release-costs-the-emitter-e--h-f-the-two-gaps)); (5) `_border`, the escape through an open face and the border `lifetime` booked as clicks; (6) `_merge`, identical rows at one Node become one row with the amounts added, antiphase rows of one record cancelling. Before the steps the engine's frame reads the measured events' steps (the drive per axis) and after them the clocks' turn and count ([MIGRATION, the interval in named steps](MIGRATION.md#the-interval-in-named-steps-on-2026-09-21-host-only-bit-exact)). Every step is one of the six verbs on the state vector: the flight, the phase, the age and every count are translations of an accumulator by its rate; the push and the click's weight are bilinear forms with declared matrices; the merge is the group-ring addition; the collision and the gate are permutations; the tables at the click are the evaluation at the N-th root of unity; the carry of every count and the one threshold of the click are the Euclidean division with the remainder kept ([record section 5.7).

**The tables are generated, not written.** A body's rule per family is generated from the families' keys, a free family read and a paid one measured; a world declares only what differs: a window, a `rerelease` with its directions and weights, a `pass`, a `become`, a `reads` component ([record 18 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#18-i-approve-1-and-3-and-2-with-the-physicist)). The engine branches on no family's name, kind or physical word, the first test; every rule is one primitive with declared integers serving every family, and a family's special cases are values and not branches ([record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201)). Nothing at a Node holds state beyond the events there, the GameBoard is O(1) per Node, and the apparatus's layer that holds the live records is at the one-way place, the only non-local operation, whose host cost is paid by the host ([record 74](LOG_2026-09-20.md#74-the-principles-of-amplitude-v1-in-ten-sentences)).

**The contract.** Every physical change follows the [local integer operation contract](ARCHITECTURE.md#local-integer-operation-contract): generic law ownership, integer intermediates, causal inputs, formula-free payloads; and [LOCALITY-1](../SIMULATOR_DEFINITIONS.md#locality-1-end-to-end-local-physics): fixed local work and storage for a fixed K, six neighbours, no global estimator; a diagnostic may reject a run and never repairs its state. A test exercises one generic rule on a minimal GameBoard with its integers pinned before the first run; a milestone is one fingerprinted run, never a suite ([section 5.5](#55-acceptance-tests-and-open-decisions); [skills/workflow.md](../skills/workflow.md)).

## 5.3 Couplings, fields and timing

Written again on 2026-09-22; the text as it stood is in [section 10](#10-the-head-and-the-reading-map-before-2026-09-22-history).

**The one coupling.** There is no field: a field is the crowd of rows a body reads at its Node ([record 2 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#02-the-law-of-events-no-fields-no-matter-no-registers-only-events)). What a body takes from the rows arriving at its Nodes is the push, the signed inner product over the columns a family declares per unit of content, per column the whole part off the reader's clock of the label flow **V** times the reader's charge in the column times the arriving family's value: gravity every family's first column, charge the second, a paid family's rows giving the label itself; the bilinear form **C** **a** with **C** the reader's charges; a force of nature is a column with a sign and a lifetime on its family, never a code path ([record 27](LOG_2026-09-20.md#27-decided-one-mechanism-for-all-the-laws-on-the-gameboard), [record 35](LOG_2026-09-20.md#35-the-mathematicians-verdict-on-the-columns-correct-and-working); BEAM_LAW note 31; `columns-v1`). A release costs the emitter by its phase rate, E = h f with h the family's declared `quantum` ([record 10 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#10-i-approve-the-proposal-a-release-costs-the-emitter-e--h-f-the-two-gaps)); a moving reader's Doppler is the count of the rows it crosses, 1 +- v / c on an axis, and no rule adds it ([record 158](LOG_2026-09-20.md#158-the-crossing-rule-designed-record-153s-order-the-physicist-read-only-scratchpad-crossingdesignmd-with-crossing_simpy-main-unchanged-a-row-and-a-body-meet-once-at-the-crossing-of-their-world-lines-a-body-at-rest-reads-arrivals-as-today-in-the-interval-of-a-step-it-also-meets-the-rows-that-crossed-its-own-link-the-other-way-and-the-rows-resident-at-the-destination-moving-against-it-and-it-does-not-meet-the-rows-moving-with-it-the-rows-behind-it-on-its-link-or-one-interval-later-the-rows-it-met-at-the-origin-the-leapfrog-the-bodys-own-two-last-links-are-the-only-facts-nothing-at-a-node-proved-on-the-experimenters-streams-toward-k--4-45-reads-in-32-intervals-k--8-58-in-48-away-19-in-32-38-in-48-rest-48-no-row-twice-none-missed-the-integer-form-moves-_move-before-the-law-and-makes-met-the-crossing-expression-doppler-v1-and-g-deleted-with-the-list-the-emergent-doppler-exact-on-the-axis-and-the-transverse-an-encounter-count-on-a-fan-direction-a-limit-to-state-not-to-tune-admissible), - **The system is integer vectors and tensors with operations on them, and the GameBoard computes exactly where the formula has only a limit** (the owner, 2026-09-21): the state integer vectors on tori and the reading's order-2 tensor; the law one map of six operations per interval at every Node; a constant rate a closed form the GameBoard only confirms, a state-dependent rate a difference equation the GameBoard iterates and the derivation takes to its limit; the measurement the one threshold read out. Why it holds: every rule audited is one of the six operations (record 168); the division with the remainder kept is a bijection whose carry is the quantum and the click's weight an inner product ### Decisions of 2026-09-20

- **`wave` is the default reading of a detector, `beam` a declared option**; Bell must read S = 2 unchanged under it — [record 02](LOG_2026-09-20.md#02-decided-wave-is-the-default-reading-of-a-detector-beam-a-declared-option); supersedes [record 24 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#24-decided-the-detector-key-reading-beam-by-default-the-pairing-rule-and-wave-the-coherent-sum-an-option) (`beam` by default); under `amplitude-v1`, `sum` is the reading of the one pointer over a record, `wave` over the crowd, one scope key (unification 4, record 86).
- **The principle**: "on the game board a ray, and in the world a wave is received", the standing statement of the model — [record 03](LOG_2026-09-20.md#03-the-principle-on-the-gameboard-a-ray-in-the-world-a-wave); read since the evening as a statement about a crowd: the sum the click reads is over the rows of one record, and the wave is the form the list of clicks draws ([record 77](LOG_2026-09-20.md#77-the-corrected-sentence-without-a-caveat-and-the-wave)). Restated on 2026-09-22 by records 762 and 768: Inside the GameBoard a beam by the law's algebraic formulas, Outside the amplitudes' passage, the wave the form the list of clicks draws.
- **The name of the board is GameBoard** ("that is what it is to be called in English in every place, also in the code: GameBoard") — [record 05](LOG_2026-09-20.md#05-decided-the-name-of-the-board-is-gameboard); landed with the names, record 44.
- **Series G, the Hubble diagram behind the detector** ("let it check whether what is observed today is also seen in our detector") — [record 10](LOG_2026-09-20.md#10-decided-series-g-the-hubble-diagram-behind-the-detector); landed, record 32; its "surprise" is not a finding, record 60.
- **Every experiment shows its results on a page with the GameBoard drawn**, why it was tested and what the conclusion is — [record 12](LOG_2026-09-20.md#12-decided-every-experiment-shows-its-results-on-a-page-with-the-gameboard-drawn). the gallery's pages and tool go with the thin worlds; a page is made only for what the paper needs.
- **The GameBoard is deterministic; the detector's world is not**, by the uncertainty principle in the detector's world — [record 15](LOG_2026-09-20.md#15-decided-the-gameboard-is-deterministic-the-detectors-world-is-not-by-the-uncertainty-in-the-detectors-world).
- **Two kinds of readings**: a detector reading, the only kind reality has, and a GameBoard reading, the host's view ("In reality there is no such thing"); a comparison with nature uses detector readings only — [record 20](LOG_2026-09-20.md#20-decided-two-kinds-of-readings-in-reality-there-is-no-such-thing).
- **The experimenter's skill**: every real experiment measures behind a detector or at an external thing; "the GameBoard is not measurable by a human" — [record 22](LOG_2026-09-20.md#22-decided-the-experimenters-skill-the-gameboard-is-not-measurable-by-a-human).
- **The strong force's range is a lifetime, L** ("excellent, go for it"): a family key counted on the event's own age; the event whose age reaches L makes no next event but an escape click in the ledger — [record 23](LOG_2026-09-20.md#23-decided-the-strong-forces-range-is-a-lifetime-l); the strong force landed as series I, record 61.
- **The weak force is arranged in the world's terms, and the law is asked what else it predicts** ("Arrange the weak force according to our world, and check whether we predict more things") — [record 25](LOG_2026-09-20.md#25-decided-the-weak-force-is-arranged-in-the-worlds-terms-and-the-law-is-asked-what-else-it-predicts); the physicist's design, record 36; landed as `weak-v1`, record 78.
- **"Our laws are on the GameBoard; in the detector one sees other laws"**: a comparison with nature is always between detector readings and nature's laws, never between the GameBoard's rules and nature's laws — [record 26](LOG_2026-09-20.md#26-decided-our-laws-are-on-the-gameboard-in-the-detector-one-sees-other-laws).
- **One mechanism for all the laws on the GameBoard** ("maybe one mechanism for all the laws on the board?"; "just check that it is correct and that it works"): the one coupling a signed inner product over the columns a family declares per unit of content, gravity the column every family has — [record 27](LOG_2026-09-20.md#27-decided-one-mechanism-for-all-the-laws-on-the-gameboard); the mathematician's verdict on the columns, record 35.

### Decisions of 2026-09-19

- **One speed**: "A quantum passes, like everything, at the speed of light between Nodes"; what we see are events, and only through a Detector — [record 01](LOG_2026-09-19.md#01-one-speed-and-what-is-seen).
- **The law of events: no fields, no matter, no registers; only events** — [record 02](LOG_2026-09-19.md#02-the-law-of-events-no-fields-no-matter-no-registers-only-events); superseded the same day by the law of the ray (record 15).
- **"I approve the proposal"**: a release costs the emitter by its phase rate, E = h f with h the declared `quantum`; the two gaps recorded — [record 10](LOG_2026-09-19.md#10-i-approve-the-proposal-a-release-costs-the-emitter-e--h-f-the-two-gaps).
- **The law of the ray** ("Go with what we talked about, fast; there is no wave in the Node", record 14): the Node holds no wave; a unit is a ray with a record on the digital line of its momentum at one speed; the collision a bijection; the click the only one-way border; an open face is a detector — [record 15](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); named the Beam Law on 2026-09-20 (record 37 of that day). The GameBoard of a run is open on every face (what leaves is a click on the face detector), an axis may be periodic, a closed one is refused; the closed board of 2026-09-18 ([record 20](LOG_2026-09-18.md#20-the-board-of-a-run-is-closed-and-k-is-a-constant)) is superseded.
- **"I approve 1 and 3, and 2 with the physicist"**: the tables generated from the keys and a world declares only what differs; the one reading function the amount-weighted moments of order 0, 1 and 2 of the direction vectors; the push as one bilinear form, with the physics-rule review — [record 18](LOG_2026-09-19.md#18-i-approve-1-and-3-and-2-with-the-physicist).
- **"Try; check what code can be cleaned; the ray is NatureBeam everywhere; make sure there is optimization in everything"** — [record 19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#19-try-check-what-code-can-be-cleaned-the-ray-is-naturebeam-everywhere).
- **The detector key `reading`**, `beam` by default and `wave` the coherent sum, an option — [record 24](LOG_2026-09-19.md#24-decided-the-detector-key-reading-beam-by-default-the-pairing-rule-and-wave-the-coherent-sum-an-option); superseded by [record 02 of 2026-09-20](LOG_2026-09-20.md#02-decided-wave-is-the-default-reading-of-a-detector-beam-a-declared-option) (`wave` the default, `beam` a declared option).
- **`charge` is the charge per unit of content of a family**, an integer or a pair [n, d]; a measured event's charge is that times its content; the push one product — [record 26](LOG_2026-09-19.md#26-decided-charge-is-the-charge-per-unit-of-content-of-a-family-the-push-one-product).
- **Detector as physical Nodes**: "The detector is itself Nodes"; "The important thing is the detector sensitivity" — [record 28](LOG_2026-09-19.md#28-detector-as-physical-nodes-cell-sensitivity-and-information).
- **Separate entity definitions**: "The detector settings are in an entity definitions file, not in the engine" — [record 29](LOG_2026-09-19.md#29-separate-entity-definitions).

### Decisions of 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-18 (superseded on 2026-09-19 by the law of the ray)

- **The Detector's bit is a property of the ray** (2026-09-17) — [record 03](LOG_2026-09-18.md#03-the-detectors-bit-is-a-property-of-the-ray); superseded by the law of the bit the next day.
- **A click is an absorption** (2026-09-18) — [record 04](LOG_2026-09-18.md#04-a-click-is-an-absorption).
- **The law of the bit: the thing or its shadow**, its definitions and its points 15 to 25, the five rules settled, "a thing does not emit" then "a thing emits" — [records 05 to 26](LOG_2026-09-18.md#07-the-law-of-the-bit-the-thing-or-its-shadow); superseded the same evening by the law of the shadow.
- **The law of the shadow: only shadows and events** (2026-09-18, the evening) — [record 29](LOG_2026-09-18.md#29-the-law-of-the-shadow-only-shadows-and-events); superseded on 2026-09-19 by the law of events, then by the law of the ray.
- **The board of a run is closed, and K is a constant** (2026-09-18) — [record 20](LOG_2026-09-18.md#20-the-board-of-a-run-is-closed-and-k-is-a-constant); the GameBoard of a run is open since the Beam Law (a closed one is refused).

**How to add a record.** A record of a day (a reading, a finding, a run, a proposal, a question, the owner's words) is appended to `docs/LOG_<date>.md` under the next `### NN.` heading, never to this section; only a decision of the model owner is added here, as one line under its date with a link to its record. A number is never reused or moved, and a record is never edited.


## 5.5 Acceptance tests and open decisions

*[History, labelled: the open decisions of 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-18 carry their closing notes; the tests rule of 2026-09-17 stands in skills/workflow.md; the engine of events was deleted on 2026-09-19 ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray)).]*

Every supported operation needs declared initial ownership, input, operator, expected output and model time, conserved readouts, edge cases and failure conditions. Accepted principles are not reopened by missing code or tests. Numerical family rules and Detector distributions need explicit closure where still undefined. The once-only encounter requirement needs independent tick traces and implementation evidence. A stated acceptance requirement is not a passing test.

**How tests are written and run (model owner, 2026-09-17).** The engine is generic and its rules are separated, so a test exercises one generic rule in isolation on a minimal board and nothing else: one test module per rule, one per feature of the ray-event model, with the expected integers written down before the first run. No test pins the numbers of an example world, compares two worlds or reproduces a known experiment; those are research runs (section 6), made once, recorded with a fingerprint and a date, and never repeated as tests. A change is checked only against the tests that depend on what it changed, selected by the import graph; the whole suite runs together only when the shared core changes (the Node and its Ports, the order of the cycle, the bounded integers, the phase), and then once, in parallel. A physical milestone, a phenomenon that several rules produce together, is one run of the engine with a fingerprint and a dated record, not a suite. The cost of checking is proportional to the risk of the change, never constant. (2026-09-19: the tests of the engine of events are listed below, "The engine of the law of events: what the tests show".)

**Open decision: what a returned field quantum does after spreading (2026-09-17).** A returning ray retraces its line by its step count (section 5.4); once the field spreads (feature 12) a field quantum's path is no longer one line, so a quantum that a Detector returns with 0 cannot walk back to its source that way, and a field ray has no event at which to perform an inverse split. The orchestrator's proposal, to be decided by the model owner before experiment A1: the returned quantum reverses on the line it arrived by and walks back until it is absorbed by the first content its coupling responds to or reaches its source, with no inverse split; every audit stays exact since nothing is created. Until decided, feature 12 implements exactly that and says so. Settled on 2026-09-18 by the law of the bit (section 5.4, points 3 and 6): a returned shadow turns back with its heading reversed and its momentum inverted and mixes at every Node like any shadow; there is no walk and no inverse split of a shadow, and it is absorbed wherever it reaches its owner. Settled again on 2026-09-18 (the evening) by the law of the shadow (section 5.4): there is no return; a quantum that reaches held content is absorbed, and a mark returns nothing. (2026-09-19, the law of events: closed, nothing returns; "So we do not want a return to the source.")

**The constants: what is derived and what is an input (2026-09-17).** Mass ratios are derivable: the ladder of hypothesis 12 is the set of loop-closing contents under the catalog's binding table, and experiment A10 counts them against the known spectrum, the proton-to-electron ratio first. The strength of the electric coupling and the strength of gravity are inputs today: the release ratio n/d of a field family and the modulus N of the lag register (section 3.28) are declared widths, and hypothesis 14's G = ħc/(N m₀)² is a reparametrization until something fixes N. The Born table's ratios were an input of the same kind until 2026-09-18, when the model owner ruled that the table is computed from the phase width N (section 5.4, point 17). Two open hypotheses record the question, 16 (what fixes the lag modulus: the top of the mass ladder, the resolution the spreading field needs, or nothing) and 17 (what fixes the release ratio and the table: the symmetry of section 3.27 and the path counting of 3.5, or nothing); until they are answered the model predicts forms, 1/N² and 1/r², and not the values of G and α. (2026-09-18: the field family is retired, point 12, the ratio being the size of a family's shadow set, "A thing does not emit"; the lag register is retired with point 22; the Born table is computed from N, point 17; what fixes G remains hypothesis 16's question.) (2026-09-18, the evening, the law of the shadow: the size of a shadow set became a rate with "A thing emits", ρ, the release per unit of held content per interval, the orchestrator's name, and it is the input for the strength of a force, the model owner's to choose; what fixes G remains hypothesis 16's question.) (Under the law of events, 2026-09-19: the inputs are the declared widths of the world file of 5.4, ρ, K, N, the suspension's width, the exchange rate of a paid family and the detectors' sensitivities; nothing else is free.) (Superseded on 2026-09-20 by the model owner on issue #369, section 5.4 and [record 106](LOG_2026-09-20.md#106-decided-the-masses-and-charges-are-the-initialisation-the-catalog-of-the-families-not-derivable-in-this-law-the-two-sentences-superseded-the-binding-design-pending): mass ratios are not derivable in this law; the masses and the charges of the families are the initialisation, the catalog's declared contents and charge per unit; the ladder of hypothesis 12 and A10's count are closed by decision; the strengths of the couplings stay inputs as stated.)

**Open decisions of the law of the shadow (2026-09-18, the evening; section 5.4).** What round 8 of DERIVATIONS.md must show before the new engine (feature 20, field-only-v1) is trusted, none of it assumed: that a held content is stable, its gravity and electricity free and its light paid; that its step, a release toward the neighbour and an absorption there, keeps it at or below the field's speed; that a content in uniform motion absorbs no net momentum from its own field, which is inertia; that bound contents exchanging quanta give the ladder of hypothesis 12; and what a split and a pair creation are as tables. Open with them, the orchestrator's list, flagged: what a mark that misses does, what the steering of two things of one family becomes, what a decay is as a table on held content, and what the siblings of one event are when nothing walks a path. Not open: Bell, two events of one field at two places, each born of the local field and the local setting, at most 2 (reading (vii)). The value of ρ, the rate of release, is the model owner's, as the size of the shadow set was. (2026-09-19, the evening, the model owner: "No confrontations are needed. Only tests that everything is as designed." The engine is the one engine without any of the above shown by a run; what round 8 was to show stays a list of research questions for runs made when wanted and registered in EXPERIMENTS.md, not a condition of anything; what round 8 did show on paper is in DERIVATIONS.md sections 51 to 56. The two choices decided as declared widths the same day, the phase turn in flight and the quantum of a family, are in 5.4's status line.) The model owner, 2026-09-20: "the architect is to make sure the names of the system are uniform, that none is redundant, and that each has a definition in Highlights of how it is computed." The architect's table follows, read from the code with every formula in integers as the code forms it; the last part lists the redundancies with the one name recommended, which the orchestrator adopts as the naming plan (executed with the NatureBeam rename). A name's row is the definition; the law's owner document stays RAY_LAW (renamed BEAM_LAW on 2026-09-20 with the names NatureBeam and GameBoard, record 44).

**As built at main 7e523c55 (PR #457, 2026-09-21).** The tables below are the architect's snapshot of 2026-09-20 at `1884b8b5` and `f88443f2`, kept as the dated definition of the names; what the engine does since is [BEAM_LAW section 3](BEAM_LAW.md#3-the-nodes-interval-nature_beam) and its notes ([note 10 onward](BEAM_LAW.md#10-implementation-notes-2026-09-19-the-implementation)), and it differs from the snapshot in these ways: the law is `"law": "beam"`, the record `beam-v1` (record 37); the interval's order is the frame, the measured events' steps, the law, then the clocks' turn and count, and a row and a body meet once at the crossing of their world lines, the key `doppler` and the grain G deleted (the crossing rule, note 48); every count of a body is `by_drive` on an accumulator of its own record, `by_clock` its constant-rate identity, the counts one table on the record, the flight rule the position's accumulator off the age with the name "flight table" retired, no remainder discarded at run time (note 17 as amended, note 41); the push is the signed inner product over the columns with the reader's charges read at the frame, the row carrying nothing of the emitter but its number (`charge` and `mass` gone from the row), the lifetime, the held content and the contact through the table (notes 27, 28, 31); `wave` is the default reading (note 29); the age is whole on the record, the age moment and `age_bound` built (note 25); the window's width, a paid family's charge per unit of amount, `become` and the W (note 36); the meeting under the key `meeting` (note 35); every lamp births records and the one click reads them, the key `amplitude` and the crowd's pointer threshold deleted (note 37 (x)); the hand (note 39); binding-v1's give (note 40); the group structure named (note 42); the mass of a bound set and the parity (notes 43, 44); the crowd audit (note 47); the exact phase at the click, the phase at the exact time of the row's last Link, read at every end of a row (note 45); the birth wheel, `wheel` [r, W] declared on every lamp with no default, u = ordinal x r mod W the record's coordinate on the ladder with the rungs on W (note 46); the click's weight the bilinear form on the record's phase-count vector with the Gram matrix of the tables, the pointer a report (note 37 (xii)). Not on main at that commit: form B (record 301), covariant-readings-v1, optical-v1, colour-v1 and the event-driven scheduler (decided, not built).

Architecture review, 2026-09-20, for the model owner's glossary. Read from the
code at `1884b8b5` (branch `claude/universe24-new-3ytqde`; the detector as a
set with one record merged at 00:06 UTC) with the formulas checked line by
line at `f88443f2` and re-read where the merge changed them. Every formula is
in integers as the code forms it; `//` is the floor division, `isqrt` the
integer root, `mod` the remainder. "Same name" says whether the code, the
tests, the tools, the examples and the live documents (RAY_LAW, ENGINE,
TERMINOLOGY, the READMEs) use one name; the aliases found are listed and the
recommended single name is in the last section. Bounds: every amount, content,
momentum component, K and tick is refused above 2^62 - 1 (`AMOUNT_BOUND`,
`MOMENTUM_BOUND`); a charge and a quantum above 2^30 - 1 (`MAX_VALUE`).

### The ray's record (`NatureBeam`; the store's columns, all int64)

| Name | Computed in | Definition | Defined in | Same name; aliases |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | walk; `RayStore.flat` | the flat index `x (Y Z) + y Z + z`; after a step `coordinates + step_d(age)`, wrapped on a periodic axis; through an open face the row leaves (a face click) | RAY_LAW 2, 3 step 1 | no: `position` (x, y, z) in `NatureBeam`, `state.json` and the measured event |
| `direction` | collision only | an index of D; the label's and the flight's direction; changed only by the collision table (a single unit in a slot) | RAY_LAW 2, 4 | no: "heading" for the six unit vectors (indices 2 .. 7, `PORT_HEADINGS`); `arrival` (the direction the row arrived on this interval, `HERE` = 0 if it did not step) |
| `age` | walk | the flight phase: `(age + 1) mod L_d` at every interval for a moving direction; kept for a rest direction; 0 at birth; in flight: kept whole, the flight reading `age mod L_d` | RAY_LAW 2, 3, note 2 | no: `Measured.age` is the clock (self-creations); `clock_age` its value before the frame's advance |
| `phase` | walk | `(phase + phase_per_link) mod N` at every Link crossed; stamped by the emitter at birth; kept by a re-emission | RAY_LAW 2 | yes |
| `number` | birth | the last emitter's number; a re-emission stamps the re-emitter's | RAY_LAW 2 | yes; "owner" (`RayWorld.owners`), "emitter" (prose) |
| `amount` | merge | whole units; identical rows are one row with the amounts added (`merge`, bounded) | RAY_LAW 2, note 3 | no: "units" (ledger `face_units`, `escaped_units`, prose "in units") |
| `content` | birth | the content one unit carries: `h x s` for a paid ray, 0 for a free one; an identity field of the merge | RAY_LAW 2 | no: "carried" (`t_carried`, `content_absorbed`: amount x content), `held`, `mass` |

### Redundancies and inconsistencies, with the one name recommended

1. **presence / scalar / count** — one quantity, three names (`Reading.scalar`, `Measured.presence`, `Readings.presence`; `Readings.count` is `outside`; "count" also names `owed` and the `beam` record). Recommend: `presence` for the scalar everywhere (`reads: "presence"`), `arrived` for `outside`, `owed` for the clock, `clicks` for the beam record.
2. **flow / vector** — `Reading.vector`, `Readings.flow`, "net flow", "label moment". Recommend: `flow` (`reads: "flow"`), and `label_flow` for V.
3. **pointer / amplitude / coherent sum / coherent reading / the wave** — one (X, Y). Recommend: `pointer` (with `amplitude` for the row's `32 x amount` only).
4. **here / rest** — `here` is the reading of rows that did not step (rest rays and dwelling rays); a rest direction is index 0 or 1; `HERE = 0` reuses the rest index as the arrival code. Recommend: `here` for the reading, `rest` for the two directions, a distinct constant `NO_ARRIVAL` for the code.
5. **suspension / owed / the count / the clock's count** — recommend: `suspension` for the key, `owed` for the state and the prose.
6. **label / momentum / push** — the row's label is written as `push` on a detector click and as `momentum` on a face click and a step; `push` should mean a push taken. Recommend: `momentum` on every record line that carries a label; `push` only in `read`/`rerelease`/`home` (what the reader took).
7. **kind / quantum / KINDS** — `kind` is deleted for families; `configuration_validation.KINDS` is the preflight's kind of document. Recommend: rename `KINDS` to `DOCUMENT_KINDS` or drop it (one kind).
8. **heading / direction** — keep `direction` for a ray's field and the table; `heading` only for the six unit vectors (`PORT_HEADINGS`, the collision's slots).
9. **tick / interval** — the code and the records say `tick`; the documents and Highlights say "interval". Recommend: `tick` in every record key and identifier, "interval" as the prose noun defined once in TERMINOLOGY as "the step tick t -> t + 1".
10. **turn / turns / phase_steps** — `FlightTable.turns` (T_d) is a homonym of the clock's `turn`; `Measured.phase_steps` (the cumulative turn) is a homonym of `RayWorld.phase_steps` (N). Recommend: `FlightTable.resolution` for T_d, `Measured.turned` for the cumulative turn, `N` kept as `phase_steps`.
11. **K / clock** — resolved on 2026-09-20: the key `K` is `NatureBeamWorld.K` as declared and resolves to the pair `turn_rate`; the turn is the release at that rate.
12. **width** — the push's `width`, the phase window's "width" (TERMINOLOGY), the detector set's "width" (Highlights), the suspension's "fractional width". Recommend: `width` for the push only; "window" for `phase_window`; "extent" for a set's Nodes; "rate" for `suspension`.
13. **amount / content / held / mass / carried / measured_content** — `amount` is units for a ray and content for a measured event; `mass` on a ray is the emitter's `held`; `carried` is `amount x content`. Recommend: `content` for a measured event's key (in place of `amount`), `emitter_content` for the column `mass`, `carried` documented once as `amount x content`.
14. **units / amount** — `face_units`, `escaped_units`, "in units". Recommend: `amount`.
15. **events / clicks** — `Measured.events` holds the clicks (`run.json` says `clicks`). Recommend: `clicks`.
16. **node / position** — `node` on event lines and in the store, `position` in `state.json`, the world and `Measured`. Recommend: `node` for the triple in every record (TERMINOLOGY: the Node is the location).
17. **model / model_id** — `run.json` writes `model`. Recommend: `model_id`.
18. **measured** — the run's list, the ledger line, the tally by rule and the reader's number on an event line. Recommend: `reader` for the event line's field (its partner `number` -> `emitter`), `taken` for the tally, `measured` for the line and the list.
19. **RULES vs TABLES** — `measured.RULES` (`home, read, measure, rerelease`, the tally keys) is not the rule set (`world.TABLES`: `read, measure, rerelease, pass`). Recommend: `TALLIES`.
20. **reads / reading / Reading / Readings / read** — five near-homonyms. Recommend: `reads` (the component key), `reading` (the detector's law, `beam`/`wave`), `Moments` for the class `Reading`, `BoardDiagnostics` for `Readings`, and the record field `reading` -> `component`.
21. **push_form** — five documents name a function that does not exist; the push is computed inline in `nature_beam` step 4. Recommend: either extract `push_form(...)` as the documents say (one place, the same integers) or correct the five documents to "the push of step 4 in `nature_beam`".
22. **Leftovers of the deleted engines in live names**: `test_repository_hygiene.duplicate_files(ignore_run_duration)` keys on `disturbance_types`; `OLD_KEYS` (23 refused keys) and `EVENTS_KEYS`, `REVERSIBLE_KEYS` are refusal tables (keep, they name the law in the refusal); `ui.py`'s renderer CSP and `.html` branch (audit A9); the `events` package name (kept by the design: a ray is an event in transit); `Sec-Fetch-Site` is an HTTP header, not the deleted noun.
23. **`face:*` as a user detector name** — accepted by the parser, two `face:+x` in the record. Recommend: refuse a detector name in `FACE_NAMES`.

## 5.7 From the world we see to the vector world: the conversions, the principles, what is derived and what is input (2026-09-21)

The model owner, 2026-09-21 (translated): "update the Highlights immediately on the system: mainly how the conversions work and why, from the physical world we see to the world of vectors; the principles; what is derived, what is needed and why." Written by the Boss from the decisions of 2026-09-21 (records 173 to 198 of [LOG_2026-09-20.md](LOG_2026-09-20.md)); the mathematics is in [DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md](DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md) and [vector_form/LAW.md](designs/vector_form/LAW.md); the law's code contract stays [BEAM_LAW.md](BEAM_LAW.md). Notation: a scalar plain, a vector in bold lowercase, a matrix or an operator in bold uppercase, every symbol named at its first use.

**The statement** (the owner, record 181). The state is integer vectors on tori and one tensor; the law is one map **F** (the interval's map) at every Node, made of six operations; the GameBoard computes exactly where the formula has only a limit; the measurement is the one threshold read out.

**The three conversions**, how the world we see becomes vectors and comes back:

1. *From a thing to a vector.* A row (a message in flight) is a point of a product of circles and lines: its Node (the GameBoard's translation group Z_X x Z_Y x Z_Z), its direction (an index of the fan F_P), its phase (the circle Z_N), its age, its amount and its number. A record (an apparatus's one message) is the vector **f** of Z^N of the amounts that ended at each phase per (end Node, label), an element of the group ring Z[Z_N]. A body (a measured event) is its held contents, its momentum vector **p**, and its counts table, one accumulator (s, r, d) per count: the drive, the turn, the owed count, the push per column, the release, the lamp's wheel. A Node is an index and holds nothing (record 155).
2. *From the world to a reading.* Nobody sees the state. A detector reads its Node's neighbourhood by one linear reading **R**: the moments of the arriving rows, order 0 a scalar (the presence), order 1 a vector (the flow, the pointer), order 2 a tensor (the spread) and the age moment; the same content as physics' stress-energy tensor **T** (density, current, stress): a detector reads **T**, never a metric (record 196).
3. *From a reading to a bit.* The click is one bilinear form on the record, the weight **f**^T **G f** with **G** = **E**^T **E** the Gram matrix of the rounded cosine and sine tables, then one threshold [u < b_k] against the rungs of the cells' cumulative weights, u the lamp's wheel written on the record at its birth (a scalar on the circle Z_W; the wheel decided, [record 180](LOG_2026-09-20.md#180-the-wheel-as-the-generic-vector-form-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0105z-the-owners-words-translated-the-wheel-was-also-turned-into-a-generic-vector-wasnt-it-the-bosss-yes-taken-as-the-decision-on-record-163-3-the-birth-wheel-is-one-row-of-the-counts-table-on-the-lamps-record-acc--2531-acc-mod-4096-the-translation-on-the-torus-z--4096-that-every-count-is-the-lamp-writes-the-rows-value-on-the-record-at-birth-as-u-at-the-click-the-cells-cumulative-weights-are-sums-the-rungs-2-w-c_k--t--2-t-one-declared-rounding-and-the-choice-u--b_k-the-wall-test-so-the-whole-click-is-a-multiplication-by-declared-matrices-an-addition-an-inner-product-and-a-threshold-no-step-of-its-own-the-map-record-164-showed-the-same-clicks-as-the-bit-reversed-ordinal-within-one-click-at-4096-births-physically-the-lamps-phase-at-the-moment-of-birth-at-a-rate-incommensurate-with-its-birth-rate-built-as-item-3-of-the-click-pull-request-after-the-exact-phase), on main at 7e523c55 (PR #457, 2026-09-21): `wheel` [r, W] declared on every lamp, no default, u = ordinal x r mod W, BEAM_LAW note 46). - *Equations first, runs as confirmation* (the main course, record 176). The linear block (rows) has a closed form and its clicks are computed before the run; the feedback block (a body whose rates read the crowd) is iterated by the GameBoard, per interval as built and over events once the scheduler to the next carry is built (record 190; decided and not built, record 191), and its continuum limit is the derivation's equation, which a run confirms with exact integers.
- *The generic vector form first* (record 177). A rule is written as the operation of a declared matrix, table or rate before its physical name; the engine branches on no name.
- *After the detector* (record 205). An experiment names, before the run, the vector or tensor it will read and its form: the record exposes scalars (counts, phases, amounts, ages), integer 3-vectors in declared units (**p** the momentum vector, **f** the net flow vector, a Node as a position), the traceless second-moment tensor **T**, and the record's phase-count vector; these readings are the only kind reality has.
- *A formula gives, a run proves* (record 205). The expectation of every experiment is derived from the law's operations before the run and registered with its derivation beside the number; the run compares, equal or a bounded deviation with its cause named; a run without a derived expectation is a research run and says so; the derivation mathematician's targets are the source of the series' expectations, a target not reached marking a quantity a run may only measure.

**What is derived**, from the six operations and the register's integers alone ([DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md](DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md)): c; Newton and Coulomb from the bilinear coupling; Doppler from the crossing rule; Born's rule as the unique reading (the lattice Gleason, 6.5: rotation-invariant, conserved at the balanced splitter and non-negative forces a positive quadratic form, the power 2 register-pinned to [1.917, 2.489)); Young's spacing and Bohr's levels; the delay field's equation; the information cost and the classical-quantum boundary (the click); special relativity as the symmetry of the limit. And what is not: gamma (the Lorentz factor) is not one of the six, a moving clock reads the bond's own slowing (1.383 x rest at 0.43 c against 1.107), a different law (record 178); the harmonic constants of the click's form (register-pinned); the masses (PREDICTIONS 26). Superseded on 2026-09-22 by records 749, 774 and 777: Lorentz is the symmetry of the clicks Outside, arrived at from the click theorem's two assumptions to second order, W = E'_0^2 + 3 p.p the Inside formula it reads; gamma is still not one of the six, and the law's rows hop whole (NATURE 4b's FAIL stands).

**What is input, and why** (record 189):

1. *The grain of the computation*, constants of the law and not of the world: N (the circle of phases), Q (the pace's grain), P (the sphere of directions), W (the birth wheel, `wheel` [r, W] on every lamp since 7e523c55), G (the fan's grain; no constant of the engine as built at main, the grain G = 2^12 of doppler-v1 being deleted with the crossing rule, BEAM_LAW note 48), K (the clock's pair) and the declared roundings at load (the tables at 1/256, T_D by isqrt, u_d). They are resolutions: in the limit the derivation reaches the known formulas; the law's claim is that the world's grain is finite, and PREDICTIONS 26 says what it quantises (what lives on a compact group: phases, directions), never the masses.
2. *The table of families and the width*, the physical inputs: per family the content (the mass number, on Z, free), the cost h (E = h f), the charge per unit of content rho, the strong column sigma, the lifetime L, the phase rate n / d, the hand; and the width S (the push per unit of content per unit of flow, which carries what physics calls Newton's G). These are the numbers physics measures and does not derive either.
3. *The state and the apparatus*: the GameBoard's extent and boundaries, the bodies' positions, momenta and held contents, the rows placed, the lamps' rates and directions, the detectors' thresholds and windows, the splitters' matrices, the gates.

If the law is right, the input to the real world is the family table, the initial state and one grain; c, h and G are units there as here. In the words of 2026-09-22 (records 768 and 772): the family table, the initial state and the grain are pushed in from Outside, and Outside represents reality.

**The three tests of every rule** (the owner, 2026-09-21, record 202), the admission test of the law, applied by the reviewer to every rule before it enters and by the implementer before it is written: (1) *generic*: one primitive with declared integers (a rate, a wall, a matrix, a table) and no family name or kind, the same primitive serving every family, its special cases values and not branches (a row is a body of no content), the engine branching on no name; (2) *vector*: one of the six verbs on the state vector, its rate at most bilinear in the state, no root, no float, no rounding at run time beyond the ones declared at load; (3) *local*: reading only its own record and the six neighbouring Nodes, fixed work and storage for a fixed K, nothing kept at a Node, every host reading labelled host. A rule that fails one test does not enter the law; a hypothesis that needs more (a seventh verb) is stated under its own identity, outside the law, until it passes or the owner admits the verb. Form B was the first rule read against the three (record 201).

**Why the three tests give the least computation in the large system, and a generic system ruled by small conditions** (the owner's question, 2026-09-21, record 206). True in this sense: the cost of an exact run is the number of events times a constant, and nothing in it grows with the GameBoard's size or the number of families; the number of events is the floor of any exact computation (each carry is a change of the state that must be made at least once), and below it lies only the linear block's closed form, which the vector test provides. *Local* bounds the work per Node per interval (six neighbours, a fixed number of accumulators for a fixed K), so the total is linear in the active Nodes and, between events, in the events; a rule reading beyond its neighbours would cost the board's size per Node. *Vector* makes every step a fixed number of bounded-integer operations with no iteration inside a step, no root, no solver, no transcendental function, gives the rows a closed form (one operation per event, not per interval), and lets the same operation run on every row at once. *Generic* makes one primitive serve every family, one code path and one table, so the cost per event is constant across kinds, the large world costing per event what the small one costs, and one primitive is verified instead of one per family. The limits: the count of events is what it is; the several-arm click is evaluated through its rank-2 factorisation, not the tensor form; the host's own costs (the state's writing, the record's format) are outside the law. And it follows that a generic system is ruled by small conditions: under the three tests the only free numbers are the family table's small declared integers, the width and the initial state; a large system has no parameter and no rule of its own scale (sections 3.21 and 3.22), so every large-scale law is the iterate of the small local rule and every known formula its limit; a change of one small condition propagates through the one primitive to every scale and moves the registered integers everywhere, exactly and never as noise, which is the system's falsifiability.

**The transformation from the GameBoard to the observed values** (the owner, 2026-09-21, record 210). Every value we see in the world is a detector's reading, so a quantity of the GameBoard becomes an observed value only through a named reading, and the derivation's targets are those transformations. The first dictionary, completed by the derivation mathematician as the targets close:

| The observed value | On the GameBoard | The reading that produces it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| a distance | Links along a digital line | a row's round-trip flight time (a light clock as a ruler) or the fan's angle (a parallax); never the Link count itself |
| a time | intervals | a body's own clock: its turn count (its proper time) and its owed count (section 9) |
| a speed | Links per interval (a body's drive, a row's pace) | what a moving reader counts, Doppler 1 +- v / c through the crossing rule (target 2), or a flight time between two detectors |
| a mass | the content M | the push a body reads (target 3), the clock's slowing near it (series E) and the mass a detector reads of a bound body (binding) |
| an energy or a frequency | the phase rate n / d, the cost h | E = h f, the cost per phase step; the click's amount |
| a force | the push per interval, the coupling **C a** | the momentum change a body's drive shows (the orbit's closure, series D) |
| an angle or a direction | a direction of the fan F_P | the click's Node on a screen (the fan's cell), the pointer's phase |
| a probability | the Gram weight **f**^T **G f** | the click's frequency over records as the wheel sweeps (Born, 6.5) |
| c | 1 / sqrt 3 Links per interval | a ruler-and-clock reading between two detectors: a unit conversion (record 191) |

The consequences: an experiment produces its observable by a detector declared in the world file, never by reading the host's state (the register's pins are detector readings); the comparison of the law with nature goes through the transformation in both directions; a GameBoard quantity is never compared with nature directly.

**The road from code to formulas** (the owner, 2026-09-21, record 211): the chronology of how the work went from the run as the evidence to the derived number that a run confirms is [CODE_TO_FORMULAS.md](CODE_TO_FORMULAS.md), each step with its record.

**The three worlds** (the owner, 2026-09-21, record 212): every thing of the system defined in the vector world, the software world and our world, with the six transformations between them, is [THREE_WORLDS.md](THREE_WORLDS.md); a thing missing from that table is missing from the law's vocabulary.
